Existing evaluation practices---reconstruction loss, rollout fidelity, action recovery, or downstream performance---cannot isolate this distinction. We introduce the Latent Action Support Ratio (LASR), a dimensionless metric that measures, under offline evaluation on held-out data, whether a learned latent provides predictive support for action-related targets beyond the current state and non-action alternatives. LASR provides two complementary summaries: GeoLASR captures typical support, while WorstLASR identifies the weakest case. We instantiate the LASR benchmark with recorded actions and corresponding physical state changes as targets, episode-held-out splits, one predictor type for all comparisons, and positive and negative controls. Experiments on recorded robot manipulation data and a matched multi-task panel demonstrate that LASR detects known action information, rejects representative non-action shortcuts, and enables graded comparisons among imperfect latent representations. We further use LASR to train and audit a lightweight residual adapter, obtaining descriptively better point estimates whose uncertainty is assessed with paired comparisons. LASR thus provides a principled offline protocol for measuring action-related predictive support in world-model latents.

AI.tldr: 提出 LASR（Latent Action Support Ratio）指标，在离线留出数据上衡量潜在动作表示在"扣除当前状态及非动作替代变量"后能否为动作相关目标提供额外预测支持。
AI.motivation: 大规模视频缺乏动作标注，潜在动作模型从观测序列中推断动作类变量，但改善未来预测的潜在变量可能只是编码了当前状态、片段进度、任务身份等预测捷径；现有评估（重建损失、rollout 保真度、动作恢复、下游性能）无法区分这一差别。
AI.method: 定义无量纲指标 LASR：以记录的动作及对应物理状态变化为目标，采用留出 episode 的离线划分，全部比较使用同一预测器，并设置正/负对照；给出 GeoLASR（典型支持）与 WorstLASR（最弱情形）两种汇总。在机器人操作数据与匹配的多任务面板上实例化基准，并用 LASR 训练/审计轻量残差适配器，以配对比较评估不确定性。
AI.result: LASR 能检出已知的动作信息、拒绝代表性的非动作捷径，并在不完美潜在表示间进行分级比较；据此训练的残差适配器给出描述性更优的点估计。
AI.conclusion: LASR 为衡量世界模型潜在表示中动作相关预测支持提供了原则性的离线评测协议。属于评测/metric 类工作，缺乏新方法或真实部署证据。

title: Towards Seconds-level Video Representation: Quadratically Gated Feature Grid with Adaptive, Prediction-free Sampling
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Code available at this https URL
summary: Implicit neural video representations are notoriously slow to build, which does not cross the basic practical threshold for most industrial applications. Here, we present Q-GAS, a coordinate-queryable video representation that couples multi-resolution explicit 3D feature grids with a compact SwiGLU-style quadratic-gating (QG) decoder and an error-aware, prediction-free sampler. The explicit grids avoid hash-collision coefficient sharing at the cost of modestly higher storage yet greatly boost the expressive capacity; the QG decoder introduces low-rank local second-order interactions to improve the nonlinear feature response. During fitting, a global error map periodically refreshes a high-error pool, and each batch mixes pool samples with uniform samples, which is free from the auxiliary model to predict difficult samples, thereby further escalating the efficiency. On UVG Beauty/Bosphorus/Jockey, Q-GAS fits and quantizes under 50 s on one RTX PRO 6000, decodes at over 370 FPS with mixed precision and about 146 FPS in FP32. In our PyTorch implementation, Q-GAS trains and quantizes 5.5-7.2 times faster than the evaluated Instant-NGP baseline and 19-28 times faster than RNeRV. Under a 90 s budget, it improves PSNR/MS-SSIM/LPIPS over the evaluated NeRV-family pipelines at comparable BPP over the measured overlap. We have shared our code at this https URL for readers' free use.

AI.tldr: Q-GAS：以多分辨率显式3D特征网格+低秩二次门控（SwiGLU式）解码器+误差感知无预测采样器构建可坐标查询的隐式视频表示，在单张RTX PRO 6000上50秒内完成拟合与量化，混合精度解码>370 FPS，训练速度较Instant-NGP快5.5–7.2倍、较RNeRV快19–28倍。
AI.motivation: 隐式神经视频表示（如NeRV族）拟合速度极慢，无法满足工业应用的实用门槛；同时哈希编码存在哈希碰撞导致的系数共享、表达能力受限的问题。
AI.method: 1) 用多分辨率显式3D特征网格替代哈希编码，避免碰撞共享系数，以略高存储换取更强表达能力；2) QG解码器引入低秩局部二阶交互，增强非线性特征响应；3) 误差感知、无预测的采样器：全局误差图周期性刷新高误差样本池，每批将池采样与均匀采样混合，无需辅助模型预测困难样本；4) 拟合后进行量化，支持混合精度推理。
AI.result: 在UVG Beauty/Bosphorus/Jockey上，50秒内（单卡RTX PRO 6000）完成拟合与量化；混合精度解码>370 FPS，FP32约146 FPS；PyTorch实现下训练+量化比Instant-NGP基线快5.5–7.2倍、比RNeRV快19–28倍；90秒预算内，在可比BPP下PSNR/MS-SSIM/LPIPS均优于所评估的NeRV族流水线。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式网格+轻量二次门控解码器+无预测误差采样，将隐式视频表示的构建时间压到数十秒量级，兼顾压缩率与还原质量，具备实用化潜力；但仅限离线视频表示学习，未涉及动态3D重建或机器人感知。

title: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
summary: Direct weight editing offers a gradient-free alternative to fine-tuning pretrained detectors, but its generalization and the value of large language model (LLM) guidance remain uncertain. We evaluate five experimental phases using YOLO26 models and MS COCO, comparing deterministic scaling, random perturbations, differential evolution, CMA-ES, structured interventions, real local-LLM proposals, failure-aware guidance, and hybrid LLM-CMA-ES against a matched random-policy control. Optimization uses native Ultralytics mAP50-95 on 1,000 COCO Val2017 images; selected candidates are assessed on a disjoint, previously examined 1,500-image subset, with COCO API AP50-95 reported separately where available. Increasing the CMA-ES budget from 8 to 250 evaluations raised development gains from +0.11 to +0.28 percentage points, while selection changes remained negative (-0.03 to -0.12 points); the 250-evaluation result uses one seed. The hybrid LLM approach showed no statistically established advantage over random-policy guidance (p = 0.612, 0.369, and 0.694 at budgets 8, 25, and 50). Five-seed YOLO26m replication yielded a COCO API AP difference of +0.004 points (95% CI: -0.026 to +0.034). Of 225 archived LLM proposals, 53 satisfy the final strict schema; early tensor-level execution cannot be fully verified. Genuine LLM-mediated weight editing is feasible, but the tested approaches did not demonstrate consistent transfer beyond the development subset or a measurable LLM advantage.

AI.tldr: 该文评估了基于梯度无关的检测器权重直接编辑（确定性缩放、随机扰动、DE、CMA-ES、结构化干预、本地LLM提议、失败感知引导、LLM-CMA-ES混合）在YOLO26+MS COCO上的迁移性与LLM增益。
AI.motivation: 直接权重编辑可免梯度替代微调，但其泛化性及LLM引导是否真正有价值尚不明确，需严格对照实验检验。
AI.method: 五阶段实验：CMA-ES预算从8增至250次评估；LLM提议与随机策略控制在8/25/50预算下对比；YOLO26m五种子复现；以Ultralytics mAP50-95在1000张Val2017优化、在互斥1500张子集上评估，并报告COCO API AP50-95；统计检验与提案schema合规率分析。
AI.result: CMA-ES开发子集增益由+0.11升至+0.28个百分点（250次预算仅单种子），但选择集变化为负（-0.03至-0.12）；LLM混合相对随机策略无统计显著优势（p=0.612/0.369/0.694）；YOLO26m五种子AP差+0.004（95% CI -0.026~+0.034）；225条LLM提案中53条满足严格schema，早期张量级执行无法完全验证。
AI.conclusion: LLM介导的权重编辑可行，但未表现出跨开发子集的稳定迁移，也无可测量的LLM优势；小样本、单种子与负结果提示此类方法收益有限。

title: Vision-as-a-Tool: Visual Harness for Multimodal Agentic Coding
comment: 27 pages, including references and appendices. Project page: this https URL
summary: Multimodal agentic coding requires robust visual reasoning to analyze observations and evaluate generated artifacts. Current frameworks largely rely on a Thinking-with-Images paradigm, where agents depend on their intrinsic vision to execute visually grounded tasks. However, this architectural coupling introduces a fundamental bottleneck. Agent performance remains strictly bounded by internal perceptual limitations. Furthermore, text-only agents lack native perception. Without specialized tools, they cannot perform visual reasoning. To overcome these constraints, we introduce the Vision-as-a-Tool (VaaT) paradigm. Prior visual tool-use merely manipulates images for an agent's intrinsic vision to read. In contrast, VaaT reframes general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as callable external utilities. As a result, text-only agents can completely offload visual reasoning during agentic execution. Meanwhile, vision-capable agents can dynamically augment their native perception on demand. We instantiate this paradigm in VHarness, a unified framework driven by five atomic actions. We comprehensively evaluate VHarness across Image-to-HTML, Image-to-SVG, and Image-to-3D generation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that VHarness consistently improves visual fidelity and geometric accuracy across both text-only and multimodal coding agents. These findings highlight that modularizing visual reasoning into callable utilities provides a flexible and scalable foundation for future agentic coding systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 Vision-as-a-Tool (VaaT) 范式，把通用 MLLM 当作可调用的外部视觉工具，并用 VHarness 框架（五个原子动作）让纯文本与多模态编程智能体按需外包视觉推理，在 Image-to-HTML/SVG/3D 任务上提升视觉保真度与几何精度。
AI.motivation: 现有 "Thinking-with-Images" 范式将视觉能力与智能体架构强耦合：性能受内部感知上限约束，而纯文本智能体无原生视觉能力，缺少专用工具时无法进行视觉推理。
AI.method: VaaT 范式：区别于以往"操作图像供内置视觉读取"的视觉工具使用，将 MLLM 重新定义为可调用外部工具，使视觉推理可在执行过程中完全卸载（text-only 智能体）或按需增强（vision-capable 智能体）；以 VHarness 统一框架实例化，由五个原子动作驱动。
AI.result: 在 Image-to-HTML、Image-to-SVG、Image-to-3D 三类生成任务上评测，VHarness 在纯文本与多模态编程智能体上均一致提升视觉保真度与几何精度。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉推理模块化为可调用工具，为智能体化编程系统提供灵活、可扩展的基础；但证据限于生成类基准，缺少真实机器人或在线部署验证。

title: Multimodal Person Concept Model for Person Identification under Varying Observation Conditions
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to Artificial Life and Robotics (AROB Journal Track). Project page: this https URL
summary: Service robots in domestic and office environments must identify users to provide personalized services based on their preferences and previous interactions. This is challenging because only a few observations may be available for learning, while observation conditions change owing to appearance, environmental noise, and utterance content. To address this challenge, this study proposes a multimodal person concept model that learns person concepts from a small number of observations, without person labels, and enables robust identification under changing conditions. The model employs a nonparametric Bayesian generative model based on the Chinese restaurant process and integrates visual, acoustic, and linguistic features extracted using Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) and Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP), followed by principal component analysis (PCA). We evaluated six participants under eight conditions in which appearance changes, additive noise, and transcription errors were introduced individually and in combination. Averaged over the eight conditions, the proposed model achieved an identification accuracy of 0.89 while inferring the number of person concepts from the observations, which is comparable to k-means clustering that was supplied with the true number of participants (0.88). We also examined PCA dimensionality, modality availability, and variation strength, and demonstrated the model on a Toyota Human Support Robot. These results show that multimodal person concept learning supports robust person identification under changing conditions, and that identification can succeed even when the number of concepts is not correctly recovered. The project page and demonstration video are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出基于中文餐馆过程的非参数贝叶斯多模态"人物概念"生成模型,融合CLIP视觉/语言与CLAP音频特征并PCA降维,在无人物标签、样本极少且表象/噪声/转写误差变化条件下实现鲁棒人物识别。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人需通过识别用户实现个性化服务,但可观测样本极少、无人物标签,且外观、环境噪声与语音内容不断变化,单模态识别易失效。
AI.method: 采用基于中文餐馆过程的非参数贝叶斯生成模型自动推断人物概念数量;视觉、声学、语言特征分别由CLIP与CLAP提取后经PCA降维并融合;无需人物标签即可从小样本学习人物概念。
AI.result: 6名被试×8种条件(外观变化、加噪、转写错误及其组合)平均识别准确率0.89,与已知真实人数(即概念数)的k-means(0.88)相当;并分析PCA维度、模态可用性与变化强度,在Toyota HSR实机上完成演示。
AI.conclusion: 多模态人物概念学习可在条件变化下支持鲁棒人物识别;即使概念数未被正确恢复,识别仍能成功,说明非参数贝叶斯融合对标签稀缺与分布漂移具有容忍性。

title: SceneAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Portable Game Scene Generation
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: Moving a scene generator to a new game engine requires more than exporting its final output: planning, construction tools, and stored experience may also depend on the original backend. We present SceneAgent, a multi-agent framework for reusing the construction process and its experience across backends. A canonical SceneContext maintains the evolving world, while backend adapters isolate coordinate conventions, asset bindings, and export. Structured handoffs let fresh Builder sessions query this persistent state without inheriting the full construction transcript. Across generations, human-approved traces are distilled into asset-ID-free Layout skills and semantic Content skills that can be retrieved and recombined. We introduce GameSceneBench, comprising 69 indoor and outdoor prompts. Under a common asset and evaluation protocol, SceneAgent obtains human tie-adjusted preference scores of 78.2-89.4% against five baselines. Ablations show that reusable skills and the multi-agent protocol primarily improve prompt alignment and scene completeness, with additional runtime. Deployment in a second engine preserves the shared construction protocol and skill library while replacing backend integration components. Together, these results support separating persistent scene state, task-local reasoning, and reusable experience for portable scene construction.

AI.tldr: SceneAgent: 多智能体框架，用规范化的 SceneContext 状态 + 后端适配器，把场景生成器的构建过程与经验跨游戏引擎复用；提出 GameSceneBench（69 条室内外提示），偏好胜率 78.2–89.4%，并在第二引擎上完成部署验证。
AI.motivation: 将场景生成器迁移到新引擎时，导出结果之外，规划、构建工具与已积累经验都绑定在原后端上，导致经验无法复用。
AI.method: 以规范 SceneContext 维护演化中的世界状态；后端适配器隔离坐标约定、资产绑定与导出。结构化交接使新的 Builder 会话可查询持久状态而不继承完整构建记录；跨代将人工认可的轨迹蒸馏为无资产 ID 的 Layout skill 与语义 Content skill，可检索与重组。
AI.result: 在统一资产与评测协议下，对五个基线取得 78.2–89.4% 的人类 tie-adjusted 偏好分；消融显示可复用技能与多智能体协议主要提升提示对齐与场景完整性，代价是额外运行时；在第二引擎部署时仅替换后端集成组件，保留共享构建协议与技能库。
AI.conclusion: 应把持久场景状态、任务局部推理与可复用经验三者分离，以实现可移植的场景构建。

title: Beyond Endpoints: Bézier Paths for Vision Foundation Model Adaptation
comment: 47 pages
summary: Frozen vision foundation models can be adapted by learning a few prompt tokens shared across all images. When prompts are updated as data shift or tasks change, the distribution of image features moves from one endpoint to another. Prior theory asks which endpoints prompts can reach; we ask whether they can travel between them along the shortest path. Because shared prompts compete with each image's own content for attention, they often cannot. We quantify this restriction as the extra transport cost that shared attention imposes over the shortest path. In an exactly solvable attention model, the reachable features form a cone; unrolling it into a plane gives the exact minimum action for every pair of endpoints and explicit optimal prompts on short arcs. The analysis reveals a sharp threshold in content normalization, which measures how much attention each image's own tokens absorb: for same-sign endpoints, at most two distinct levels allow prompts to follow the shortest path, whereas three or more force a strictly positive extra cost unless the endpoints differ only by rescaling. This gap persists with more prompts, small content perturbations, and aligned multihead outputs. On ViT-B/16 with VTAB-1k, a quadratic Bézier prompt path that minimizes feature action reduces held-out transport action relative to linear and cross-entropy-trained paths between the same endpoints and improves intermediate and online accuracy under unlabeled distribution shift, while cross-entropy-trained paths retain higher minimum accuracy when labeled calibration data are available. Reachable endpoints do not guarantee a reachable shortest path: how prompts move matters, not only where they end. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 学习共享prompt token以适配冻结视觉基础模型时，图像特征从一端点移动到另一端点；本文研究prompt能否沿最短路径移动，并将共享注意力带来的额外传输成本量化。在可精确求解的注意力模型中，可达特征构成锥，可计算任意端点对的最小作用量及短弧上的显式最优prompt；发现内容归一化存在尖锐阈值：同号端点下至多两个离散水平能让prompt走最短路径，三个及以上水平则产生严格正的额外成本。ViT-B/16 + VTAB-1k实验显示，二次Bézier prompt路径在无标签分布偏移下优于线性与交叉熵训练路径。
AI.motivation: 既有理论只关注共享prompt所能到达的特征端点，忽略从一端点到另一端点之间的路径约束；而共享prompt与图像自身内容竞争注意力，可能使最短路径不可达，因此需要量化该限制并设计更优的prompt更新轨迹。
AI.method: 构建一个可精确求解的注意力模型（共享prompt与图像token竞争注意力），证明可达特征集为锥体，将其展开为平面后解析求得每对端点间的最小作用量与显式最优prompt（短弧情形）；引入"内容归一化"参数刻画图像自身token的注意力占比，并推导最短路径可达性的阈值条件；在多prompt、内容扰动、多头对齐等设定下验证结论；在ViT-B/16与VTAB-1k上以最小化特征作用量的二次Bézier prompt路径做实验对比。
AI.result: 理论：同号端点情形下，至多存在两个不同内容归一化水平使prompt可沿最短路径迁移，三个及以上水平必然产生严格正的额外传输成本（除非端点仅相差缩放）；该间隙在更多prompt、小内容扰动及对齐多头输出下持续存在。实验：二次Bézier prompt路径相比线性与交叉熵训练路径降低留出集传输作用量，并在无标签分布偏移下提升中间与在线准确率；但有标签校准数据时交叉熵训练路径的最小准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 可达端点不等于可达最短路径；prompt如何移动（路径几何）与终点位置同样重要，共享注意力的内容归一化水平决定了最短路径可达性的相变结构。该结论为prompt迁移/持续适配提供了可计算的几何准则与Bézier类路径设计思路。

title: Signal Scaffolding: Unlocking the Potential of Lightweight Models for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: With the rising demand for edge devices, lightweight self-supervised monocular depth estimation methods have continued to evolve; however, existing methods generally suffer from poor accuracy. We find that the root cause may lies in the failure of conventional training regimes to fully exploit the inherent potential of lightweight models. To address this, we propose a novel three-phase training strategy for lightweight self-supervised monocular depth estimation, termed Signal Scaffolding (SS). Without introducing any additional dataset or parameters, we apply SS to ReForgeDepth, a lightweight network of our own design. Experiments on the KITTI and Cityscapes datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in the accuracy-efficiency trade-off and running in real time on edge devices. These results suggest that lightweight models can be improved further within their existing capacity, and that the central question may be less about how parameters are allocated than about how to unlock this latent potential through training.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段"Signal Scaffolding (SS)"训练策略，在零额外数据与参数下提升轻量自监督单目深度估计网络ReForgeDepth，在KITTI/Cityscapes上取得最优精度-效率权衡并可在边缘设备实时运行。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备需求增长，但现有轻量自监督单目深度估计精度普遍较差。作者认为根因不在参数分配，而在于常规训练范式未能充分挖掘轻量模型的内在潜力。
AI.method: 设计三阶段训练课程（Signal Scaffolding），在不增加数据集和参数的前提下逐步"脚手架化"地引导信号学习；配合自研轻量网络ReForgeDepth，通过重参数化/结构重设计实现低算力推理。
AI.result: 在KITTI与Cityscapes上达到SOTA的精度-效率权衡，并在边缘设备上实时推理。
AI.conclusion: 轻量模型在既有容量内仍可提升，关键问题从"参数如何分配"转向"如何通过训练解锁潜在能力"。

title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
summary: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. But each caption or question names only a few attributes of a clip, so the model learns to retrieve those attributes rather than to read the clip, and the dynamics the encoder carries go unused: on the same items, a linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA features at 87% while the VLM answers at chance. We show where dynamics lives in a frozen encoder: in a subspace shared across videos for predictive encoders such as V-JEPA, but not as a shared component of frame-wise, text-aligned encoders such as SigLIP. We then build counterfactual supervision that makes the language model read it: pixel transformations turn public videos into answer-balanced variants whose answers are set by the transformation and differ only in the change. Trained in a single stage on 4.53M public samples with 32 visual tokens per frame, where open video LLMs use several stages, 9M to 172M samples and 64 to 256 tokens per frame on average, the resulting V-JEPA-LM models (1B to 8B, Qwen3 and Llama) lead every size class in average score across eleven video benchmarks; our 4B model scores 72.1, against 61.1 for the best open 4B and 64.8 for the best open 8B model. A controlled encoder x supervision study shows that the encoder decides what can be read and the supervision what is read: at a matched budget, counterfactual supervision adds 4.5 points on average and 38 on the speed questions of natural benchmarks. Code and models: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 冻结的V-JEPA世界模型编码器把视频动态（方向、速度、顺序、状态）编码在一个跨视频共享的子空间中，但用字幕/QA训练的语言模型只学会检索少数被提及的属性。作者用像素变换构造答案均衡的反事实监督，使LM真正"读"出动态；单阶段训练得到1B–8B的V-JEPA-LM，在11个视频基准上各规模领先。
AI.motivation: 现有"世界模型编码器+LM"的VLM里，每条字幕或问题只命名片段的少数属性，模型因此只学到属性检索而非真正读取视频，编码器携带的动态信息被浪费——同一批样本上线性探针从冻结V-JEPA特征读速度达87%，而VLM仅相当于随机猜测。作者要弄清动态信息在冻结编码器中"存在何处"，并设计监督让LM去读它。
AI.method: 1) 表征分析：定位动态信息的子空间——预测型编码器（V-JEPA）中存在跨视频共享的动力学子空间，而逐帧文本对齐型编码器（SigLIP）没有这样的共享成分。2) 反事实监督：用像素级变换把公开视频转成答案均衡的变体，答案由变换决定，变体之间仅在"变化"上不同，从而强制模型读取动态而非检索属性。3) 单阶段训练于4.53M公开样本、每帧32个视觉token，得到1B–8B、基于Qwen3与Llama的V-JEPA-LM。4) 受控的"编码器×监督"对比实验分离两者贡献。
AI.result: 11个视频基准平均分上各规模均领先：4B模型72.1，优于最佳开源4B（61.1）与最佳开源8B（64.8）；且训练成本远低于开源视频LLM（它们多用多阶段、9M–172M样本、平均每帧64–256 token）。受控实验显示：同等预算下反事实监督平均+4.5分，自然基准的速度问题上+38分。
AI.conclusion: 编码器决定"什么可被读出"，监督决定"什么被读出"：预测型世界模型编码器内含可用的动力学子空间，只有配套的反事实监督才能把它激活为语言模型可用的视频理解能力；单阶段、少token的高效训练即可超越大规模多阶段基线。

title: PADSNet: Physics-Aware Dual-Stream Network with Biomechanical Priors for Laryngeal Lesion Classification
summary: Precise classification of laryngeal lesions is clinically crucial yet highly challenging, as inter-class visual differences are often subtle. While abnormalities in vocal fold vibratory dynamics provide complementary discriminative information, existing deep learning models predominantly rely on visual appearance and lack explicit mechanisms for modeling clinically meaningful vibratory dynamics. To address this, we propose PADSNet, a Physics-Aware Dual-Stream Network for laryngeal lesion classification that integrates visual representations with explicit biomechanical reasoning. Specifically, a Wavelet-Attention Enhancement Module (WAEM) is designed to bridge the spectral-semantic gap, enabling complementary learning of spatial texture and dynamic frequency representations. Meanwhile, a Knowledge Computing Module (KCM) extracts interpretable biomechanical indices from temporal glottal distance waveforms, including indicators of mobility, symmetry, glottal closure, and vibration stability. These descriptors are subsequently incorporated into a Physics-Aware Gating Module (PAGM) as biomechanical priors to adaptively recalibrate visual feature toward pathology-relevant vibratory patterns. Extensive experiments on a clinical dataset demonstrate that PADSNet achieves an accuracy of 0.8452, an F1-score of 0.8090, a sensitivity of 0.7953, and a specificity of 0.8866. These results indicate that explicitly integrating biomechanical priors with deep visual representations provides a more accurate, robust, and clinically interpretable framework for automated laryngeal lesion classification.

AI.tldr: PADSNet：用于喉部病变分类的物理感知双流网络，用声带振动动力学（声门距离波形）提取的生物力学指数作为先验，通过物理感知门控模块调制视觉特征，临床数据集准确率0.8452。
AI.motivation: 喉部病变类别间视觉差异细微，仅靠外观难以判别；声带振动动力学提供互补判别信息，但现有深度学习模型缺乏显式建模临床意义振动动力学的机制。
AI.method: 双流架构：小波-注意力增强模块(WAEM)弥合频谱-语义差距，学习空间纹理与动态频率表示；知识计算模块(KCM)从时序声门距离波形中提取可解释生物力学指标（活动度、对称性、声门闭合、振动稳定性）；物理感知门控模块(PAGM)以这些指标为先验对视觉特征做自适应重标定。
AI.conclusion: 显式融合生物力学先验与深度视觉表示可为喉部病变自动分类提供更准确、稳健且具临床可解释性的框架。

title: DoubleTake: Focused Verification of Visual Evidence for Long-Document Understanding
summary: In long-document question answering, a vision-language model can answer incorrectly even when the retrieved pages contain sufficient evidence. Rereading those pages with the original question gives the model little guidance about which fact to check. We introduce DoubleTake, a training-free framework for focused verification of visual evidence. An initial reading produces a candidate answer and a separate evidence record that guides retrieval for a second reading. A planner compares the two candidates and their supporting evidence to formulate a factual question. A verifier answers it from the source images without seeing either candidate or evidence record, and a reasoner uses this observation to resolve the original question. With a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone, DoubleTake achieves the highest overall accuracy among the evaluated methods on each of four benchmarks. With the same pages and number of model calls, asking a focused factual question yields higher accuracy on all four benchmarks than asking the original question again. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: DoubleTake：免训练的长文档VQA聚焦验证框架——二次阅读时由规划器基于两个候选答案与证据记录生成具体事实问题，验证器在不见候选答案的情况下仅凭原始图像作答，再由推理器裁定最终答案。
AI.motivation: 长文档问答中，即使检索到的页面包含充分证据，VLM 仍可能答错；而"带着原问题重读这些页面"对模型几乎没有指引作用，模型不知道应该核对哪个事实。作者希望把二次阅读从"重复原问题"改造为"验证一个明确的、聚焦的事实性提问"。
AI.method: 免训练、多角色流水线，冻结骨干为 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct：①首读（initial reading）产生候选答案及一份独立的证据记录（evidence record）用于指引检索；②对检索页做第二次阅读得到第二个候选；③planner 对比两个候选及其支撑证据，提炼出一个事实性核查问题；④verifier 在看不到任何候选答案与证据记录的条件下，仅依据源图像回答该问题（避免确认偏误）；⑤reasoner 结合该观察结果裁决原问题。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，DoubleTake 的整体准确率均为所比较方法中最高。关键对照实验：在页面相同、模型调用次数相同的条件下，"提出聚焦的事实性问题"在全部四个基准上均优于"重新提问原问题"，直接验证了方法设计的核心假设。
AI.conclusion: 二次阅读的有效性取决于"问什么"而非"再读一遍"；将复核转化为对无偏验证器的聚焦事实提问，可在不训练、不增加调用次数的情况下稳定提升长文档视觉问答准确率。

title: Per-Agent-Safe Navigation of Globally Driven Robot Collectives via Affine Field Design
comment: 9 figures, 1 table
summary: Safe navigation of robot collectives requires coordinating motion and deformation so that the collective can traverse constrained environments while ensuring each robot's safety. Existing controllers for swarmalator collectives largely rely on local control, where each robot receives an individual command, which causes the control and communication requirements to grow with the number of agents. We introduce a broadcast control formulation in which a single spatially affine field governs both the motion and deformation of the collective. The scalar component of the field regulates collective size, and its spatial gradient generates collective translation through non-reciprocal interactions. Both components enter the collective dynamics directly, which allows per-robot wall, actuation, and cohesion constraints to be enforced using control barrier functions within a single quadratic program for the whole collective. The resulting controller continuously adapts the collective size to the local environment, and enables safe passage through corridors narrower than the unconstrained collective without pre-planned resizing. We further derive how the available actuation budget determines the reachable speed and minimum passable corridor width, and we demonstrate that two independently driven collectives can simultaneously traverse a shared junction using distinct fixed phase labels without inter-collective coordination.

AI.tldr: 提出广播式（空间仿射场）群体控制方法：单一标量场调节群体尺度，其空间梯度通过非互易相互作用产生平移，将每个机器人的墙壁、驱动与内聚约束统一写入单个二次规划（QP）的控制障碍函数，实现无需预先规划的自适应缩容穿越窄通道，并推导了驱动预算与可达速度/最小可通行宽度的关系。
AI.motivation: 现有 swarmalator（同步—聚集）群体控制器多为局部控制，每台机器人需独立指令，控制与通信开销随个体数量线性增长；同时群体需要在受限环境中移动并形变，且保证每个个体的安全性，缺乏可扩展且带硬约束保证的统一配方。
AI.method: 广播控制公式化：用一个空间仿射场同时支配群体运动与形变。场标量分量控制群体尺寸（缩放），空间梯度借助非互易相互作用生成集体平移。两分量直接进入群体动力学，使得各机器人的墙壁避碰、执行器饱和、内聚约束可用控制障碍函数（CBF）在同一个覆盖整个群体的二次规划（QP）中求解；控制器在线根据局部环境连续调整群体尺寸。另推导驱动预算对可达速度和最小可通行走廊宽度的约束关系。
AI.result: 控制器可连续自适应群体尺度，无需预先规划缩容即可安全通过比无约束群体更窄的走廊；给出了执行器预算决定可达速度与最小可通行宽度的解析关系；两组独立驱动的群体可在无跨群协调的情况下，凭借不同的固定相位标签同时通过共享交叉口。
AI.conclusion: 以广播场替代逐个体指令，可在保持单群体级QP与硬安全约束的同时解决可扩展性问题，并给出驱动能力—速度—最小通道宽度的设计指导，支持多群体在共享枢纽中无协调共存。

title: Speed-Variation Distillation for Generative Modeling
comment: CDEL-ECCVW 2026 proceedings. Project page: this https URL
summary: While diffusion models excel at image generation, their denoising trajectories pass through corrupted intermediate states far from the image manifold. We ask whether generation can instead proceed through recognizable images throughout the entire trajectory. We introduce a generative framework built around a variation-reducing degradation process that contracts diverse images toward a shared prototype while preserving recognizable intermediate states. Because such manifold traversal lacks a simple analytical form, we construct the trajectories using generative-prior-based image morphing. We then distill the reverse process into a diversification operator that transforms the prototype into increasingly varied samples. To resolve the one-to-many ambiguity of the reverse process, we associate each trajectory with its initial noise latent and apply perturbations to improve robustness against accumulated errors. At inference, every step yields a recognizable image, allowing early termination and enabling a controllable speed--variation trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"全程可辨识"的生成框架：用变化收缩型退化过程将多样图像映射到共享原型，以生成先验驱动的图像变形构建轨迹，再蒸馏出多样化算子反向生成，每步均输出可辨识图像，支持提前终止与速度-多样性权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型去噪轨迹经过远离图像流形的损坏中间态，缺乏可解释性；作者追问能否让生成过程全程经过可辨识图像，从而获得可解释、可提前终止、可调节速度与多样性的生成路径。
AI.method: 1) 设计"减变化"退化过程，将多样图像收缩至共享原型且保留可辨识中间态；2) 因该流形遍历无解析形式，用基于生成先验的图像变形(morphing)构造轨迹；3) 将逆向过程蒸馏为多样化算子，把原型逐步扩展为多样样本；4) 针对逆过程一对多歧义，将轨迹与其初始噪声隐变量关联，并加扰动增强对累积误差的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果；定性上声称推理每一步均产生可辨识图像，因而支持提前终止，并实现可控的速度-多样性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以可辨识轨迹替代传统扩散的破坏性中间态，提供了"任意步截断即得有效图像"的生成范式，属于图像生成范式层面的探索，与具身智能/3D重建等方向关联较弱。

title: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
comment: Accpted by KDD 2027
summary: Cities account for over two-thirds of the world's energy and more than 70% of global carbon dioxide emissions. City energy is essential for achieving the 2050 net-zero target and the UN's Sustainable Development Goals 7 and 11. Although existing studies have made progress, they are limited by data and methodological gaps. Existing studies are largely predictive for existing cities rather than generative for future cities; fine-grained, aligned monthly dynamic energy data are scarce; and existing GenAI models struggle to generate dynamic urban functional monthly energy. We present DySENSE, a joint multimodal GenAI framework that synthesizes static urban satellite imagery together with spatially aligned, dynamic monthly building energy consumption maps. We decouple long-term static urban morphology from short-term dynamic energy consumption. By conditioning on static urban land use, DySENSE can generate realistic, diverse and new static urban imagery with aligned energy maps. By conditioning on dynamic monthly and climate prompts, DySENSE can jointly generate dynamic, monthly energy consumption maps while keeping the urban morphology static. Experiments across four cities (New York, Washington, Norfolk, Busan) demonstrated that DySENSE can generate annotated high-fidelity synthetic energy data using less than 25% labelled data, boosting downstream prediction performance by 8% mIoU, and achieving strong energy dynamic consistency. Compared to existing methods, DySENSE significantly improved prediction performance (8.7% accuracy) and reduced prediction error (9%-18% CVRMSE, ASHRAE). DySENSE offers an effective foundation for energy-efficient cities, peak-load analysis, building performance simulation and dynamic demand response for city, energy, and building science. The data and code: this https URL and this https URL

AI.tldr: DySENSE 是一个多模态联合生成框架，将城市静态卫星影像与空间对齐的动态逐月建筑能耗图解耦建模，支持"给定静态土地利用生成城市影像+能耗图"与"给定动态月度/气候提示生成能耗图而保持形态不变"，用不足25%标注数据合成高保真带注释数据。
AI.motivation: 城市占全球能耗2/3以上、CO2排放70%以上，是实现2050净零与SDG 7/11的关键。现有研究多为面向既有城市的预测而非面向未来城市的生成；细粒度、空间对齐的逐月动态能耗数据稀缺；现有GenAI难以生成动态的城市功能月度能耗。
AI.method: 提出联合多模态生成框架DySENSE：显式解耦长期静态城市形态与短期动态能耗，采用静态土地利用条件生成城市影像、动态月度与气候提示条件生成对齐能耗图，实现影像与能耗图的联合合成；在纽约、华盛顿、诺福克、釜山四城验证。
AI.result: 仅用<25%标注数据即可生成带注释高保真合成能耗数据，下游预测提升8% mIoU，能耗动态一致性强；相比现有方法预测精度提升8.7%，误差降低9%–18%（CVRMSE，ASHRAE标准）。
AI.conclusion: DySENSE为节能城市设计、峰值负荷分析、建筑性能仿真与动态需求响应提供了可用基础，并开源数据与代码。

title: Photogrammetric 3D Model-Based Animal Behavior Classification
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 1 table, conference proceedings
summary: Video-based behavior estimation is often implemented end-to-end from image sequences. We advocate a two-stage alternative: reconstruct 3D body and object geometry before classifying behavior. This makes ambiguities of the ill-posed 2D-to-3D inverse problem explicit and potentially correctable. We demonstrate the strategy with simulated interacting mice and extend it to real video.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段视频行为估计框架：先重建3D身体与物体几何，再将行为分类建立在显式3D表征之上，从而暴露并纠正2D→3D逆问题的不适定性；在仿真互作小鼠上验证并扩展到真实视频。
AI.motivation: 端到端视频行为识别把2D到3D的不适定歧义隐式吸收到网络中，导致误差不可解释、难以纠正。作者认为先显式重建3D身体与物体几何，可使这些歧义显性化并具备可校正性。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：(1) 几何重建阶段，从多视角/单目视频重建3D身体与物体几何；(2) 行为分类阶段，在重建的显式3D几何表征上做行为判别。主要验证平台为仿真的互作小鼠，并迁移至真实视频。
AI.result: 在仿真互作小鼠场景中验证了该两阶段策略相比端到端方案在歧义处理上的优势，并成功扩展到真实视频数据。
AI.conclusion: 将3D几何重建前置、行为分类后置的模块化设计能显性化2D-to-3D的歧义并支持校正，是视频行为估计的一种可解释替代方案，但其验证限于小鼠动物行为，尚未进入机器人操作或人手–物体交互场景。

title: See and Detect: Image-Driven Open-Vocabulary Multi-View 3D Object Detection
comment: tech report
summary: Recent open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D detection methods typically follow a point-cloud-driven pipeline, where pseudo 3D boxes are generated from reconstructed or estimated geometry and semantic labels are inferred from projected regions. However, such a design makes box generation dependent on the completeness of point clouds and restricts semantic learning to local appearance, causing inferior 3D object localization and open-vocabulary classification. In this paper, we present See and Detect, an image-driven framework that uses multi-view images as the primary evidence for 3D box and semantic label generation. For box generation, we first discover object candidates from individual images, enabling objects missing in point clouds to be recovered from visual evidence. However, single-view predictions are often noisy and redundant. To address this, we propose multi-view consensus box consolidation to fuse spatially consistent predictions across views, and box quality assessment to reduce the impact of boxes with partial object coverage. For semantic label generation, we introduce context-aware semantic learning, where semantic labels are queried from full image context, enabling more accurate semantic prediction. Extensive experiments on ScanNet and ARKitScenes demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art open-vocabulary multi-view 3D detection performance while running over 500$\times$ faster than the previous state-of-the-art method.

AI.tldr: 提出图像驱动的开放词汇多视图室内3D检测框架 "See and Detect"，以多视图图像作为3D框与语义标签生成的主要依据，通过多视图一致性框合并、框质量评估与上下文感知语义学习，在ScanNet/ARKitScenes上达到SOTA且速度提升500倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇多视图3D检测沿点云驱动范式：伪3D框依赖重建/估计几何的完整性，语义标签仅从投影局部区域推断。这导致缺失点云的目标无法成框、定位不准，且语义学习受限于局部外观，开放词汇分类性能差。
AI.method: 1) 从单视图图像直接发现物体候选，使点云中缺失的目标可由视觉证据恢复；2) 多视图共识框合并（multi-view consensus box consolidation）融合跨视角空间一致的预测，去除单视图噪声与冗余框；3) 框质量评估抑制仅部分覆盖目标的低质量框；4) 上下文感知语义学习，从完整图像上下文中查询语义标签；5) 无点云依赖的推理管线带来大幅加速。
AI.result: 在ScanNet与ARKitScenes上取得开放词汇多视图3D检测SOTA，运行速度较先前SOTA方法快500倍以上；验证了图像驱动范式对目标恢复、定位与开放词汇分类的改善。
AI.conclusion: 以图像为主要证据的多视图范式可规避点云完整性瓶颈，兼具精度与效率优势，为开放词汇3D场景理解提供新路径。

title: More Genes, Faster Inference: Efficient Large-Panel Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology
comment: Accepted at KDD 2027
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) prediction from histology aims to infer spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from tissue images. This is a challenging problem that is currently often addressed with complicated model architectures, additional inputs, and complicated training procedures, while remaining limited to fixed, small gene panels. This raises a natural question: Is there an efficient method for large-panel ST prediction? Here, we present GeneFlow, a simpler yet effective framework for large-scale spatial gene expression prediction that unifies flow-matching generative modeling with structured multimodal fusion. Specifically, GeneFlow first encodes both histological morphology and cross-gene interactions in spatial spots through histology and gene tokenizers. The model directly predicts spatial gene expression, rather than an intermediate velocity field, while being trained with a velocity-based flow-matching objective. We show that, even without relying on heavy generative pipelines, GeneFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ST benchmarks, with up to 56.8% gains in 1,000-gene prediction. Extensive experiments further show that GeneFlow produces biologically meaningful spot profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, thereby improving efficiency and scalability, particularly in clinical settings. We believe GeneFlow provides an opportunity for leveraging widely available histology images for downstream biological discovery. Code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: GeneFlow：将 flow-matching 生成建模与结构化多模态融合统一的简化框架，直接从组织学图像预测大基因面板（1000基因）空间转录组表达，直接预测表达而非中间速度场，取得SOTA并大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有组织学→空间转录组（ST）预测依赖复杂架构、额外输入与繁琐训练流程，且受限于固定的小基因面板；作者追问是否存在面向大面板ST预测的高效方法。
AI.method: 用组织学 tokenizer 与基因 tokenizer 分别编码组织形态与空间位点内的跨基因交互，做结构化多模态融合；模型直接回归空间基因表达，训练目标采用基于速度的 flow-matching 损失，无需重型生成式流水线。
AI.result: 在多个ST基准上达到SOTA，1000基因预测最高提升56.8%；生成具有生物学意义的位点表达谱，计算开销降低数个数量级，提升效率与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: GeneFlow 以更简单的框架实现大面板空间基因表达预测，兼顾精度、效率与可扩展性，为利用广泛可得的组织学图像开展下游生物学发现提供途径。

title: AmbiSteer: Selectively Eliciting Ambiguity-Aware Responses in Vision-Language Models
comment: 23 pages, 23 figures
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often exhibit overconfidence, providing firm answers even when visual evidence is insufficient. A prominent case is referential ambiguity in Visual Question Answering (VQA), where multiple entities in an image are plausible referents of a question. Addressing such cases requires recognizing when ambiguity is present: ambiguous questions can be handled by asking for clarification or enumerating plausible referents, while unambiguous questions should receive a direct answer. Current VLMs struggle with this distinction, often defaulting to a single interpretation. To investigate whether activation steering can serve as an inference-time mechanism to elicit such behaviors, we introduce AmbiSteer, a lightweight framework to selectively elicit ambiguity-aware behavior. Across three VLMs, we find that steering alone has limited and model-dependent effects, while prompting is generally more effective. Combining prompting and steering substantially increases clarification and enumeration behaviors, but also elicits them on unambiguous cases. AmbiSteer addresses this using a linear classifier to predict input ambiguity and condition the steering direction accordingly, increasing the proportion of inputs handled appropriately from 59.0% to 77.0% on average across models. Our work sets the ground for lightweight approaches to reduce model overconfidence in uncertain multimodal settings.

AI.tldr: AmbiSteer：结合提示与激活引导（activation steering），并用线性分类器预测输入歧义性来条件化引导方向，使VLM在指代歧义VQA中"正确区分处理"比例从59.0%提升到77.0%。
AI.motivation: VLM普遍过度自信，在指代歧义（图像中多个合理指代对象）的VQA中仍给出确定单一答案；理想行为是歧义时请求澄清或枚举候选，无歧义时直接作答，而现有模型难以区分。
AI.method: 提出AmbiSteer轻量推理时框架：在三个VLM上检验激活引导（activation steering）能否诱发歧义感知行为；发现引导效果有限且依赖模型、提示更有效；二者结合虽显著提升澄清/枚举行为但在无歧义输入上误触发，故引入线性分类器预测输入歧义性，据此条件化引导方向。
AI.result: 单独引导效果有限且模型依赖；提示更有效；提示+引导大幅提升澄清与枚举比例但伴随误触发；加入歧义分类器条件化后，跨模型平均"处理得当"输入占比由59.0%升至77.0%。
AI.conclusion: 线性可分的歧义信号+条件化激活引导构成一种轻量、无需训练的推理时缓解多模态不确定场景下过度自信的手段，为后续工作奠定基础。

title: Zoom In, Scale Out: Metric Depth Models Mistake Digital Zoom for Moving Closer
comment: 22 pages including supplementary material. Code: this https URL
summary: Many new AI models estimate how far away things are, in metres, from a single photo. To do this they must also work out what camera took the photo. We check whether they really do with a simple test: digital zoom, that is, cropping a photo and enlarging the crop back to full size. Zooming moves nothing in the scene, so a correct model should give the same distance for every point still in the picture. The test is free, exact and needs no labels. Two numbers describe a model's reaction: its depth changes like $s^{-\alpha}$ (ideal $\alpha=0$) and its focal-length estimate like $s^{\beta}$ (ideal $\beta=1$), for zoom factor $s$. On 800 images from KITTI, NYUv2 and DIODE, the widely used Depth Anything V2 has $\alpha=0.95$: it treats a zoomed photo almost as if the camera had moved closer, because it judges distance mainly from how large things look. Models that also predict the camera remove only part of this error ($\alpha\approx0.31$-$0.36$), because their focal estimate grows too little. Given the true camera, Depth Pro and DA3-Nested keep their depth ($\alpha\approx0$), so the error lies in their camera estimate. The reason: a zoomed photo is, pixel for pixel, a normal photo of a scene squashed in depth, so size alone cannot tell the two apart, and a focal estimator trained by regression stays close to the cameras it saw in training. Undoing this needs no labels or training and makes Depth Pro pass the test ($\alpha=0.04$) at almost no cost on normal photos. Controls, including a real optical zoom lens, rule out blur and resizing artefacts. Finally, label-free fine-tuning for self-consistency lowers $\alpha$ to 0.05 on KITTI and 0.07 on NYUv2 once a "blurry means zoomed" shortcut is removed; we report what this costs on normal and unseen photos.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"数字变焦"这一免标签、精确的一致性测试，检验单目度量深度模型是否真正解耦了深度与相机焦距：理想情况下缩放后深度不变（α=0）、焦距估计按 s^β 且 β=1。实测 Depth Anything V2 的 α≈0.95（把变焦当作相机靠近），自带相机估计的模型仅部分缓解（α≈0.31–0.36），给出真实内参时 Depth Pro/DA3-Nested 的 α≈0；并给出无需训练的修正使 α 降至 0.04。
AI.motivation: 单目度量深度估计必须同时推断相机内参，但现有评测依赖带标签的深度/相机真值，难以暴露模型是"真的度量"还是"靠物体视觉尺寸猜距离"。作者希望用场景不变量构造一个免费、精确、无需标注的诊断手段，从而分离深度误差与相机估计误差的来源。
AI.method: 以数字变焦（裁剪后再放大回原分辨率）作为探针：变焦不改变场景几何，只改变视场，因此正确模型的深度应对所有保留像素保持不变。用两个指数刻画模型反应——深度随缩放因子 s 的幂律 s^{-α}（理想 α=0）与焦距估计的 s^{β}（理想 β=1）。在 KITTI、NYUv2、DIODE 的 800 张图像上测试 Depth Anything V2、Depth Pro、DA3-Nested 以及联合预测相机的模型；并用真实光学变焦镜头、模糊/重采样对照排除伪影；最后做免标签的自一致性微调（去��"模糊即变焦"捷径）。
AI.result: Depth Anything V2 的 α=0.95，几乎把变焦当作相机前移；内置相机预测的模型仅将误差降到 α≈0.31–0.36，瓶颈在焦距估计增长不足；给定真实内参时 Depth Pro 与 DA3-Nested 的 α≈0。原因是变焦图逐像素等价于"深度被压扁"的普通照片，纯回归式焦距估计会停留在训练分布附近。无需标签/训练的修正使 Depth Pro 通过测试（α=0.04），在普通照片上代价几乎为零；免标签自一致性微调将 α 降至 KITTI 0.05、NYUv2 0.07，并报告其在正常与未见图像上的代价。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个零成本、无标注的诊断基准，揭示当前单目度量深度模型普遍依赖表观尺寸捷径、相机估计与深度解耦不充分，并示范了无需训练的修正与轻量自一致性微调即可显著改善尺度-焦距一致性。

title: Cracks in Embeddings: Robustness and Stability of JEPA-Based Chest X-Ray Representations
summary: Self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models are increasingly used for medical imaging, however there is a limited understanding about robustness of these models toward real-world image changes. We test four JEPA-based chest X-ray encoders, trained on 78,468 NIH ChestX-ray14 images, under six tests: two black-box adversarial attacks (SPSA, Boundary Attack), three image corruptions (Gaussian noise, brightness shift, contrast shift), and a label-scarcity test, measuring embedding change and classification AUROC. These perturbations cause severe, model-dependent damage: encoder-level Cosine Similarity drops as low as 0.33, and AUROC falls by as much as 0.12 in the worst case (I-JEPA under the Boundary Test). We test two ways of training the small predictor on top of each frozen encoder to address this. Adversarial fine-tuning, trained on clean and perturbed images together, raises embedding consistency above 0.97 in nearly every case and improves AUROC, relative to the same perturbed baseline, for most models, with the largest gain of $+0.10$ on I-JEPA. A Vector-Quantized codebook method, trained only on clean images and evaluated on perturbed test images for the first time, instead degrades under distortion for all four models, most noticeably for I-JEPA ($-0.15$ AUROC on average), showing that its discrete bottleneck alone does not provide the robustness that comes from training on perturbed data directly.

AI.tldr: 评估四个基于JEPA的胸片编码器在对抗攻击、图像腐蚀与标签稀缺下的鲁棒性，并比较对抗微调与VQ码本两种预测器训练方案的鲁棒性收益。
AI.motivation: JEPA自监督模型在医学影像中日益普及，但其对真实世界图像变化的鲁棒性认识不足。
AI.method: 在78,468张NIH ChestX-ray14图像上训练四个JEPA胸片编码器，做六项测试（SPSA、Boundary两种黑盒对抗攻击，高斯噪声/亮度/对比度三种腐蚀，以及标签稀缺测试），以嵌入余弦相似度与分类AUROC衡量；并在冻结编码器上用小预测器做对抗微调（干净+扰动数据）或向量量化码本（仅干净数据）。
AI.result: 扰动导致严重且模型相关的性能下降：嵌入余弦相似度最低至0.33，AUROC最大下降0.12（I-JEPA在Boundary攻击下）。对抗微调使几乎全部情形嵌入一致性>0.97，多数模型AUROC提升，最大增益+0.10（I-JEPA）；仅用干净数据训练的VQ码本在全部四个模型上反而退化，I-JEPA平均AUROC下降0.15。
AI.conclusion: JEPA医学编码器对真实图像变化缺乏鲁棒性；鲁棒性主要来自直接在扰动数据上训练，而非离散瓶颈结构。

title: DiffusionSSD: Achieving Extreme Visual Compression with Dual-stage Diffusion and Cross-level Near-Data Processing
comment: 15 pages, 19 figures
summary: Growing visual data overwhelms storage on resource-constrained edge devices, making compression essential. Traditional codecs offer inadequate rate-distortion performance, motivating the exploration of diffusion codecs. Diffusion codecs face two limitations: (1) At the algorithm level, diffusion decoders preserve perceptual quality under extreme compression, but require substantial computation. (2) At the architecture level, in NPU-centered devices, neural codecs occupy the NPU, interfering with other AI applications. Meanwhile, the complex codec pipeline incurs long I/O paths, leading to additional overhead and energy cost. To address these issues, we propose DiffusionSSD, a cross-level near-data processing framework for extreme visual data compression on edge devices, using an algorithm-architecture co-design method. Specifically, (1) at algorithm level, we present Dual-stage Diffusion, a lightweight solution tailored for diffusion codecs that employs patchification and single-step diffusion, reducing computation cost while preserving perceptual quality; (2) at architecture level, we introduce a Cross-level Near Data Processing architecture that integrates the proposed computational universal flash storage (cUFS) and LPDDR-PIM, enabling codecs to be entirely offloaded to data side while reducing visual-data movement and avoiding SoC redesign; (3) at system level, combining both the algorithm and the underlying architecture, we propose a Patch-Workload co-aware scheduling scheme to enable more efficient system-level execution. Experiments show that Dual-stage Diffusion maintains comparable perceptual quality while reducing computation cost by up to 92.7%. Compared with NPU+DRAM and near-data-processing design such as SmartSSD, cUFS+PIM improves coding throughput by 2.32 times and 2.91 times on average, respectively.

AI.tldr: DiffusionSSD：面向边缘设备极端视觉压缩的跨层级近数据计算框架，通过"两阶段扩散（patch化+单步扩散）"算法、"cUFS+LPDDR-PIM"架构与"Patch-Workload协同调度"三者协同设计，将扩散编解码器完全卸载到数据侧。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备存储受限而视觉数据激增，传统编解码器率失真性能不足；扩散编解码器虽有良好感知质量，但算法上计算开销大、架构上占用NPU干扰其他AI任务，且复杂流水线导致长I/O路径与额外能耗。
AI.method: 算法-架构协同设计：(1) Dual-stage Diffusion，用patch化与单步扩散降低扩散解码计算量并保持感知质量；(2) 跨层级近数据计算架构，集成计算型通用闪存cUFS与LPDDR-PIM，将编解码器整体下沉到数据侧，减少数据搬移且无需重设计SoC；(3) 系统层Patch-Workload协同感知调度，提升系统级执行效率。
AI.result: Dual-stage Diffusion在感知质量相当的前提下计算开销最多降低92.7%；相比NPU+DRAM与SmartSSD类近数据处理设计，cUFS+PIM平均编码吞吐分别提升2.32倍和2.91倍。
AI.conclusion: 跨层级近数据处理+轻量扩散编解码的协同设计可显著缓解边缘端扩散压缩的计算与访存瓶颈，为端侧高效视觉压缩提供可行路径。

title: CardioTrace: Motion-Aware Cine Synthesis via Coupled Tracing and Segmentation
summary: Cardiac cine MRI provides time-resolved visualization of cardiac motion and is essential for evaluating ventricular function and anatomy. In routine clinical acquisition, however, cine sequences are frequently temporally sparse or degraded by arrhythmia, motion, and scan-time constraints, which can hinder reliable quantification and downstream analysis. We present CardioTrace, a motion-aware cine synthesis framework that generates a full cardiac cine sequence from limited input while explicitly modeling and tracing cardiac motion. CardioTrace couples two complementary pathways: a pixel-translation branch that directly predicts cine frames in a residual formulation, and a flow-field branch that estimates time-resolved deformation fields from a reference phase to provide interpretable motion correspondences across frames. To further preserve anatomical plausibility, a segmentation branch supervises clinically meaningful cardiac structures at key phases, and a cross-branch consistency objective encourages the synthesized appearance dynamics to follow the explicit motion guidance, mitigating temporal drift and unrealistic shape transitions over long sequences. The framework also supports prompt-style conditioning to incorporate auxiliary patient or acquisition information, improving robustness across heterogeneous multi-center data. Experiments on public cardiac cine MRI datasets demonstrate that CardioTrace improves perceptual quality and temporal coherence over representative GAN- and diffusion-based baselines, while better preserving ventricular morphology throughout the cardiac cycle. \textit{Our codes are available after review}.

AI.tldr: CardioTrace：运动感知的心脏cine MRI合成框架，联合像素平移残差分支与形变流场分支，辅以分割监督与跨分支一致性损失，从有限输入生成完整心动周期序列。
AI.motivation: 常规临床cine序列常因心律失常、运动伪影与扫描时间限制而时间采样稀疏或质量退化，影响心室功能与解剖量化分析。
AI.method: 双通路耦合：残差式像素平移分支直接预测帧；流场分支从参考相位估计时间分辨形变场提供可解释运动对应；分割分支在关键相位监督心脏结构；跨分支一致性目标约束外观动态遵循显式运动引导，抑制长序列时间漂移；支持prompt式条件注入患者/采集辅助信息以提升多中心鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在公开心脏cine MRI数据集上，相较代表性GAN与扩散基线，感知质量与时间一致性更优，整个心动周期内心室形态保持更好。
AI.conclusion: 显式运动建模与结构监督相结合可有效改善稀疏退化cine序列的合成与下游分析可用性；代码待评审后释放。

title: Vessel2Brain: Edge-Aware Multi-Scale Flow Matching for 3D Brain Image Generation from Vessel Masks
summary: Generating realistic 3D brain MRI volumes from sparse anatomical priors is a highly ill-posed yet clinically valuable problem, with important applications in data augmentation, simulation, and downstream neuroimaging analysis. In this work, we investigate the challenging task of synthesising full 3D brain MRI volumes conditioned solely on vascular label maps. While vascular structures provide strong anatomical and topological cues, they occupy only a small fraction of the brain volume and offer no direct information about surrounding tissue appearance. To address this challenge, we propose Vessel2Brain, an edge-aware multi-scale conditional flow matching framework that explicitly incorporates vascular structure information into the generative process. Our approach formulates vessel-guided brain image synthesis as a conditional continuous flow, enabling stable training and flexible generation while preserving structural correspondence. A multi-scale flow matching strategy is introduced to jointly model global anatomical coherence and fine-grained local details, with auxiliary velocity predictions providing additional supervision across spatial resolutions. Furthermore, we design an edge-aware objective that emphasises vascular boundaries during training, encouraging anatomically faithful tissue synthesis around vessel structures. We evaluate Vessel2Brain on two public 3D brain MRI datasets with paired vascular annotations. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative models in terms of reconstruction accuracy, structural consistency, and distributional realism.

AI.tldr: 提出 Vessel2Brain，一种边缘感知多尺度条件流匹配框架，仅以血管标签图为条件合成完整 3D 脑 MRI 体数据。
AI.motivation: 血管标签仅占脑体积很小比例，且不含周围组织外观信息，用其条件生成全脑 MRI 高度病态；但该任务对数据增强、仿真和下游神经影像分析有临床价值。
AI.method: 将血管引导合成建模为条件连续流（conditional flow matching）；多尺度流匹配策略联合建模全局解剖一致性与局部细节，并在各空间分辨率上附加速度预测作为辅助监督；设计边缘感知目标函数，强调血管边界区域，促使血管周围组织解剖合理。
AI.result: 在两个带配对血管标注的公开 3D 脑 MRI 数据集上，定量与定性实验在重建精度、结构一致性和分布真实性上均优于现有 SOTA 生成模型。
AI.conclusion: 条件流匹配结合多尺度与边缘感知监督可有效缓解稀疏条件的信息不足，实现拓扑对齐的 3D 医学图像合成；代码/开源情况未提及。

title: Token2Tile: Token-Wise Sparse Attention with Tile Execution through a Low-Rank Space for Video DiTs
comment: 21 pages, 14 figures, 23 tables
summary: Attention is essential for modeling spatio-temporal dependencies in video diffusion transformers, but its quadratic cost makes it a major inference bottleneck. Its high sparsity offers an opportunity to accelerate generation by focusing computation on important interactions. However, accuracy and execution favor different granularities: each query attends to its own key tokens, whereas GPU kernels work on tiles. We present Token2Tile, a training-free sparse attention operator that combines per-query scoring and a per-query residual with tile execution. An online low-rank space, computed directly from queries and keys to preserve attention logits, makes clustering, scoring, and residual approximation efficient. Token2Tile unites query-specific selections to allocate exact work across query clusters, then packs the selected keys into GPU tiles. On MiniMax-H3 and Wan2.1-14B, Token2Tile delivers 1.48-1.54x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention-3 with VBench scores within 0.5 points of dense. At comparable speeds on H3, it improves PSNR over SOL and SubBlock by 5.5-6.8 dB; on Wan, it exceeds SOL by 4.6-4.8 dB while running faster.

AI.tldr: Token2Tile：一种免训练稀疏注意力算子，结合逐查询打分/残差与 tile 级 GPU 执行，将按查询选择的键打包成 tile，在视频扩散 Transformer 上实现 1.48–1.54× 端到端加速且质量几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 中注意力具二次复杂度，是推理瓶颈；注意力高度稀疏但精度需求（逐查询粒度）与 GPU 执行效率（tile 粒度）之间存在粒度矛盾。
AI.method: 在线低秩空间（直接由 Q、K 计算以保持注意力 logits）用于高效聚类、打分与残差近似；先做逐查询选择分配到各查询簇以精确分配工作量，再将所选键打包为 GPU tile 执行；逐查询打分加逐查询残差修正，全流程免训练。
AI.result: MiniMax-H3 与 Wan2.1-14B 上相比 dense FlashAttention-3 端到端加速 1.48–1.54×，VBench 与 dense 差距 0.5 分以内；H3 同速下 PSNR 比 SOL/SubBlock 高 5.5–6.8 dB；Wan 上比 SOL 高 4.6–4.8 dB 且更快。
AI.conclusion: 通过桥接查询级精度与 tile 级硬件效率，可在免训练条件下大幅加速视频扩散 Transformer 生成，兼具质量与速度优势，属高效推理基础设施型贡献。

title: Measured from the feed: the unsustainable growth of AI video generation
comment: Main paper + Supplementary paper Under submission at a journal
summary: Text-to-video generation runs at commercial scale, but its broader environmental impacts remain, to our knowledge, understudied. Providers rarely disclose video volumes or energy needs; we measured the yearly video output of two commercial platforms and built a prospective model of such services' absolute footprint from training to storage. Our projections suggest that reducing emissions depends on both limiting growth in video generation and achieving substantial efficiency gains. Under continued growth, emissions rise nearly seventy-five-fold by 2030 despite technological improvements. When usage remains at 2026 levels, the same improvements reduce emissions by about two-fifths. These estimates are a conservative lower bound: they cover one AI service among many; other services and uses would push the total higher.

AI.tldr: 测量两家商业文生视频平台年产量，构建从训练到存储的全生命周期前瞻模型，指出若持续增长到2030年排放将增近75倍，即便技术改进；若用量维持2026年水平则同等技术改进可减排约40%。
AI.motivation: 文生视频已在商业规模部署，但其环境影响（能耗、排放）几乎无人系统研究；服务商很少披露视频产量与能源需求，缺乏绝对足迹的量化依据。
AI.method: 实证测量两个商业平台的年度视频产出量，并据此建立从模型训练、推理到存储的全流程前瞻性（prospective）排放模型，进行情景推演（持续增长 vs. 用量持平）。
AI.result: 持续增长情景下2030年排放增加近75倍，技术效率提升不足以抵消；用量维持2026年水平时，同样的效率改进可减排约40%。作者强调该估计仅为保守下界。
AI.conclusion: 减排需同时限制生成量的增长并实现大幅能效提升；本文属可持续性/政策分析，未提供可用于具身智能、VLA、3D重建或世界模型的可操作方法洞见。

title: Domain Adaptation Based Pipeline for Character Classification and Handwritten Text Recognition
summary: Character classification and handwritten text recognition, particularly in specialized tasks, often suffer from limited labeled data, while a large amount of unlabeled data remains unused. To address this challenge, we propose a novel unsupervised domain adaptation-based pipeline to reduce the distribution gap between source and target domains. Our pipeline follows three main steps. In the first step, we pretrained an expert model on source data, to learn a strong general representation. In the second step, we perform unsupervised domain adaptation to leverage unlabeled target data, adapting the model to the specific characteristics of the target domain. In the third step, we trained the expert model on source data in the target style. By aligning the feature distributions between the source and target, our method enables the model to generalize effectively across diverse datasets. The unsupervised training increases the computation time only during training not in inference. We evaluate the pipeline on both character-level and historical handwritten line recognition tasks, demonstrating its flexibility. We establish a new state-of-the-art on the Safran-MNIST-DLS dataset defined in Track 2 of the DAGECC competition with 76.17% Macro F1-score and achieve competitive results on each of the specific datasets of READ 2018 without using the labels of the target data. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段无监督域自适应流程（源域预训练专家模型 → 目标域无监督自适应 → 目标风格源数据再训练），用于字符分类与手写文本行识别，在Safran-MNIST-DLS上达76.17% Macro F1。
AI.motivation: 字符分类与手写文本识别（尤其专用场景）标注数据稀缺，而大量无标注目标数据未被利用，需缩小源域与目标域分布差异。
AI.method: 三步流水线：(1) 源域数据预训练专家模型获通用表征；(2) 在无标注目标数据上做无监督域自适应以适配目标域特性；(3) 在目标风格的源数据上重训专家模型；通过对齐源/目标特征分布实现跨数据集泛化，无监督训练仅增加训练耗时、不影响推理。
AI.result: 在字符级与历史手写文本行识别两类任务上验证灵活性；在DAGECC竞赛Track 2的Safran-MNIST-DLS数据集上取得76.17% Macro F1的新SOTA，并在READ 2018各子数据集上不使用目标标签即获得有竞争力结果。
AI.conclusion: 无监督域自适应可有效利用未标注目标数据，在专用字符/手写识别任务中以零目标标签代价提升跨域性能，且推理开销不变；代码已开源。

title: nnAEU: a Simple and Efficient CNN-Autoencoder for Hyperspectral Unmixing
summary: Deep learning-based hyperspectral unmixing (HSU) has followed a trajectory of increasing architectural complexity, from simple autoencoders to transformers and, most recently, Mamba-based models, each claiming to advance the state of the art. Contrary to this trend, we propose a lightweight CNN-based autoencoder, coined "Not New Autoencoder Unmixing" (nnAEU). It is derived from the backbone of UNMamba (2025) through a pruning study that removes the Mamba component entirely. nnAEU uses less than 10 times fewer parameters than UNMamba, and far fewer than other transformer- and GAN-based methods, while outperforming them in accuracy. We provide a complete, minimal, reproducible code, available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出轻量CNN自编码器nnAEU，通过剪枝研究发现去掉UNMamba的Mamba模块后性能更优，参数少近10倍却精度更高。
AI.motivation: 高光谱解混领域深度学习模型架构日趋复杂（自编码器→Transformer→Mamba），但复杂度的提升是否真正必要存疑，且大模型参数多、计算重、难以复现。
AI.method: 以UNMamba（2025）的主干为基础做剪枝研究，完整移除Mamba分支，得到纯CNN自编码器nnAEU；提供完整、极简、可复现的代码。
AI.result: 参数比UNMamba少近10倍，远少于Transformer与GAN类方法，同时在解混精度上优于这些方法。
AI.conclusion: 在HSU任务中，架构复杂度并非性能必需，简洁的CNN自编码器即可达到并超越SOTA，提醒领域重视可复现的基线研究。

title: MacroGS: Macro-Pixel Shared Gaussian Primitives for Arbitrary-Scale Light Field Super-Resolutio
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures
summary: Arbitrary-scale light field spatial super-resolution reconstructs high-resolution views at any requested scale from low-resolution multi-view observations. Gaussian primitives enable continuous reconstruction, but generating separate primitive sets for each view redundantly encodes shared scene structure across views and causes the primitive count grow linearly with the number of views. To avoid such redundancy, we propose MacroGS, a feed-forward decoder that jointly predicts a single shared Gaussian set per macro pixel rather than generating separate sets for each view. Disparity-dependent replacement and angle-conditioned appearance allow each set to be reused across all output views, keeping the predicted primitive count independent of the number of views at each requested scale. The decoder iteratively predicts per-primitive disparities, retrieves the corresponding multi-view features, and updates the primitive states. Gaussian splatting and residual refinement then reconstruct the output light field. Despite being learned without geometric supervision, the predicted disparities strongly correlate with underlying scene geometry. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that MacroGS integrates effectively with diverse light field encoders, improving reconstruction quality at fixed scales while achieving leading performance across most evaluated arbitrary-scale settings. The decoder also achieves speedups of approximately $2$-$10\times$ over state-of-the-art implicit light field decoders and $10$-$18\times$ over the view-wise Gaussian baseline.

AI.tldr: MacroGS 提出前馈解码器，在每个 macro pixel 上预测单一共享高斯集合，通过视差依赖替换与角度条件外观实现跨视角复用，使基元数量与视角数无关，实现任意尺度光场空间超分。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯基元的任意尺度光场超分为每个视角生成独立基元集，冗余编码跨视角共享场景结构，且基元数量随视角数线性增长，效率低。
AI.method: 前馈解码器在 macro pixel 层面联合预测单一共享高斯集合；迭代预测每基元视差、检索对应多视图特征并更新基元状态；采用视差依赖替换与角度条件外观实现跨视角复用；最终经高斯泼溅与残差精化重建输出光场。无需几何监督。
AI.result: 在五个基准上有效集成多种光场编码器，固定尺度重建质量提升，多数任意尺度设置达到领先性能；预测视差与场景几何强相关；相比先进隐式光场解码器加速约 2–10×，相比逐视角高斯基线加速 10–18×。
AI.conclusion: 共享高斯表示的视角无关基元设计在保持重建质量的同时显著降低冗余与计算开销，为高效任意尺度光场重建提供可行方案。

title: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
summary: Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) is typically formulated as a text-to-text problem. While suitable for digital texts, this formulation falls short in real-world K-12 education, where AI-assisted corrections are expected directly on essay images, which are primarily handwritten and exhibit many irregularities. To bridge this gap, we introduce Grounded Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (G-CGEC), an image-to-grounded-edit task requiring systems to predict both corrections and their positions on essay images. We propose G-CGEC-Eval, a benchmark comprising real-world images of K-12 Chinese essays with fine-grained annotations. For evaluation, we adapt IoU-based metrics from object detection and propose a more tolerant alternative based on center-distance matching. Using this benchmark, we evaluate open-source and proprietary vision-language models under a direct single-pass setting, as well as settings with auxiliary components (OCR and character grounding) coordinated via pipelining or agentic harnessing. Results show that even top-tier proprietary models perform surprisingly poorly in the single-pass setting, while pipelining and agentic harnessing yield meaningful improvements. Notably, an error-type-based multi-agent workflow achieves the best performance, establishing it as the strongest baseline for future G-CGEC research. Through ablations and fine-grained analysis, we find the task remains far from solved, with linguistic error discovery and character-level grounding as the primary bottlenecks. This underscores the need for models that better integrate visual perception with linguistic reasoning and visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 提出G-CGEC任务：在K-12手写作文图像上直接预测语法纠错结果及其在图上的位置；构建G-CGEC-Eval基准并适配IoU与中心距离匹配指标，评估开源/闭源VLM在单次直推、OCR/字符定位流水线与多智能体编排下的表现。
AI.motivation: 传统CGEC被建模为文本到文本问题，依赖数字文本，无法满足K-12教育中直接在（多为手写的、规范性差的）作文图像上给出辅助批改的现实需求，缺少任务定义、数据基准与评价方法。
AI.method: 定义image-to-grounded-edit任务；构建含真实K-12中文作文图像与细粒度标注的G-CGEC-Eval；将目标检测IoU指标迁移用于评估，并提出更宽容的中心距离匹配指标；系统对比VLM单次直推、OCR+字符定位的流水线方式、以及agentic harnessing（含按错误类型划分的多智能体工作流），辅以消融与细粒度分析。
AI.result: 即使顶级闭源模型在单次直推设置下表现也出乎意料地差；流水线与agentic编排带来显著提升，基于错误类型的多智能体工作流取得最佳性能，成为未来G-CGEC研究的最强基线；瓶颈主要在于语言错误发现与字符级视觉定位。
AI.conclusion: G-CGEC任务远未解决，需模型更好地融合视觉感知、语言推理与视觉定位；多智能体分解式编排是当前有效方向，该基准可作为后续研究的统一评测平台。

title: Reusing Locomotion Training Recipes Across Humanoids via Body-Aligned Virtual Joints
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 1 table
summary: Reinforcement learning has enabled robust humanoid locomotion, yet training recipes (rewards, architectures, hyperparameters) remain hard to reuse across robots with different native joint coordinates, since policies output native joint angles while action scales, bounds, gains, and penalties are defined in those robot-specific coordinates. Existing transmission models convert native targets into actuator commands but do not standardize the coordinate interface exposed to the policy. We introduce a body-aligned virtual joint space upstream of this mapping: policy actions and observations follow a common anatomical convention, and a deterministic kinematic layer maps virtual targets to native ones, leaving the existing transmission and low-level control stack unchanged. Under a single unmodified recipe on three humanoids with different leg-axis layouts, it is the only interface that tracks accurately, keeps the feet aligned with the travel direction, and trains stably on all three, and on Unitree G1 hardware it reduces heading drift by nearly a factor of six.

AI.tldr: 在策略与底层传动之间插入"身体对齐虚拟关节空间"（body-aligned virtual joint space），用确定性运动学层把虚拟目标映射到原生关节，使同一套reward/架构/超参可跨三种腿轴布局不同的人形机器人复用。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人RL训练配方难以迁移：策略输出原生关节角，而动作尺度、边界、增益与惩罚均在机器人特定坐标系中定义。现有transmission模型只做native→actuator映射，不标准化暴露给策略的坐标接口。
AI.method: 在transmission层上游构建统一解剖学约定的虚拟关节空间：策略的action与observation均表达在该空间中，再由确定性运动学层将虚拟目标解析映射为原生关节目标，下层transmission与低层控制器完全不变。
AI.result: 在三种腿轴布局不同的人形机器人上，使用同一未修改训练配方，该接口是唯一能同时做到精确跟踪、足部与行进方向对齐、稳定训练的接口；Unitree G1实机上航向漂移降低近6倍。
AI.conclusion: 坐标接口标准化是跨本体策略复用的关键缺失环节，可与既有transmission/低层控制栈正交叠加，成本低、收益明确。

title: RecurIR: Learning When and How to Revise Restoration Policies via Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Agent-based image restoration has achieved promising performance by coordinating restoration tools to handle heterogeneous and coupled degradations. However, existing agents often improve their decisions through accumulated successful and failed executions, without explicitly identifying the conditions under which learned restoration strategies remain effective. Consequently, changes in degradation severity, spatial coverage, or interactions may invalidate previous decisions, while providing limited guidance on how these decisions should be revised. In this paper, we propose \textbf{RecurIR}, a recursive self-improvement framework that enables restoration agents to learn when and how to revise their decision rules. Specifically, we introduce a policy-hypothesis discovery mechanism to identify testable, condition-dependent rules through matched tool executions. We then design a rule-falsification-driven task evolution mechanism to generate targeted degradation variations, examine the validity of learned rules, and identify their applicability boundaries. Based on the resulting evidence, we develop a change-conditioned policy revision mechanism that learns how variations in degradation conditions should modify tool selection, execution order, operation strength, and processing regions. We further incorporate independent verification to retain effective revisions and use the resulting feedback to guide subsequent hypothesis discovery and task evolution. Through this recursive process, RecurIR progressively refines its restoration policies as degradation conditions change. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出RecurIR递归自我改进框架，使图像修复智能体能显式识别策略有效条件（策略-假设发现、规则否证驱动的任务演化、条件变化驱动的策略修正、独立验证），并在退化条件变化时递归精化工具选择、执行顺序、强度与处理区域。
AI.motivation: 现有基于智能体的图像修复依赖成功/失败执行经验累积改进决策，未显式界定所学策略的有效条件和适用边界；当退化程度、空间覆盖或退化交互变化时，旧决策可能失效，且缺乏"如何修正"的指引。
AI.method: 1) 策略-假设发现机制：通过配对/匹配的工具执行，挖掘可检验、依赖条件的规则；2) 规则否证驱动的任务演化：生成针对性退化变体，检验规则有效性并定位适用边界；3) 条件变化驱动的策略修正机制：学习退化条件变化如何修改工具选择、执行顺序、操作强度与处理区域；4) 独立验证保留有效修正，并以其反馈引导后续假设发现与任务演化，形成递归闭环。
AI.result: 摘要仅称"大量实验验证了框架有效性"，未给出具体数据集、指标或与基线的定量对比与增益幅度。
AI.conclusion: 将"策略何时有效、应如何修正"显式化为可检验的规则与边界学习问题，是提升智能体式修复在异构耦合退化下鲁棒性与可迁移性的合理路径；但实验证据在摘要层面较薄弱，需核对完整实验设置与开源情况。

title: RSSA: Robust Semantic and Spatial Aligner for Collaborative Perception
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 18 pages, 14 figures, 11 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: V2X collaborative perception improves single-vehicle perception by aggregating multi-view features from collaborative agents. However, existing methods typically rely on simple spatial warping to align the collaborative features, which can cause semantic misalignment during fusion. Meanwhile, these deterministic warping-based methods are highly sensitive to the positional noises. In this paper, we propose a plug-in module called Robust Semantic and Spatial Aligner (RSSA), which performs semantic and probabilistic spatial transformations for robust feature alignment. Specifically, a Semantic Transformation (SemT) block modulates feature channels based on the observed relative pose to correct semantic inconsistencies. Subsequently, a Probabilistic Spatial Transformation (P-SpaT) block performs probabilistic warping by sampling from the Gaussian-modeled relative pose space. A Relative Transformation Augmentation (RT-Aug) strategy is further introduced to augment the relative poses and facilitate the training of the RSSA. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate that RSSA improves the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin under the configuration of both clean and noisy positions.

AI.tldr: RSSA：可插拔模块，用语义变换（SemT）+高斯建模的概率空间变换（P-SpaT）+相对位姿增广（RT-Aug）替代简单空间warping，实现V2X协同感知中对位姿噪声鲁棒的特征对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有V2X协同感知方法仅用确定性空间warping对齐协作特征，导致融合时语义错位，且对位姿噪声高度敏感。
AI.method: 插件式Robust Semantic and Spatial Aligner：SemT根据观测相对位姿调制特征通道以纠正语义不一致；P-SpaT从高斯建模的相对位姿空间采样做概率warping；RT-Aug增广相对位姿以促进训练。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实数据集上，干净位姿与噪声位姿两种设定下均大幅超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义+概率空间双重变换，可提升协同感知特征对齐的鲁棒性，且模块可即插即用于现有框架。

title: JaRS: Contrast-Free Localization of Memorized Regions in Diffusion Models via Jacobian Row Sums
summary: Diffusion models sometimes memorize and reproduce regions of their training images, raising privacy and copyright concerns. We aim to localize these regions. Existing contrast-based methods use the diagonal of the denoiser Jacobian, which reflects the posterior variance of each pixel. However, a small diagonal entry is ambiguous: it signals either memorization or averaging over many neighboring pixels in smooth or predictable regions. To resolve this ambiguity, these methods subtract a reference map, which requires a second evaluation with a null prompt or an earlier checkpoint. Unconditional models have no null prompt, and earlier checkpoints are unavailable in general. We show that Jacobian row sums (JaRS), unlike the diagonal, separate memorization from local averaging without a reference map. Pairing JaRS with an image-level detection score that uses the same statistic at an early denoising step yields JaRS+. Across Stable Diffusion v1.4 and v2.1, Realistic Vision v5.1, and an unconditional diffusion Transformer (DiT), JaRS+ outperforms contrast-based localization methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 Jacobian 行和 (JaRS) 统计量，无需参考图即可区分扩散模型中的“记忆化”与“局部平均”，并构建 JaRS+ 定位训练图像记忆区域。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型会记忆并复现训练图像区域，带来隐私与版权风险；现有基于去噪器雅可比对角线（后验方差）的对比方法存在歧义：较小的对角元既可能表示记忆化，也可能表示在平滑/可预测区域对邻近像素的平均，需借助 null prompt 或早期 checkpoint 生成参考图来消除歧义，而无条件模型无 null prompt、早期 checkpoint 通常不可得。
AI.method: 指出雅可比行和 (JaRS) 与对角线不同，可在无参考图条件下分离记忆化与局部平均；将 JaRS 与一个早期去噪步使用相同统计量的图像级检测分数配对，得到 JaRS+，用于记忆区域定位。
AI.result: 在 Stable Diffusion v1.4/v2.1、Realistic Vision v5.1 以及无条件扩散 Transformer (DiT) 上，JaRS+ 的记忆区域定位性能优于对比式定位方法。
AI.conclusion: 雅可比行和提供了一种无参考的记忆化度量，扩展了记忆定位方法对无条件模型的适用性。

title: A Generalizable Approach to Safety-Aware Robotic Behavior Planning with an Explicit Constraint Space
summary: Large language and vision-language models have substantially advanced robotic behavior planning from natural-language instructions and visual observations. However, safe manipulation in tabletop environments remains challenging because the safety constraints required for a task depend on the surrounding scene and may not be explicitly specified in the instruction. We propose a safety-aware behavior planning framework based on an explicit Constraint Space that stores reusable textual safety rules. Rather than retrieving rules solely by semantic similarity, we formulate constraint selection as task- and environment-conditioned applicability learning. A lightweight query-conditioned dual-tower model identifies the constraints applicable to the current context, which are then provided together with the original task and image to a multimodal behavior planner. To handle incorrect constraint selections and previously unseen hazards, we introduce a multimodal Safety Inspector that evaluates generated primitive plans, reconstructs the complete applicable constraint set, and provides corrective planning feedback. Validated inspection feedback is further used for test-time adaptation of constraint applicability and parameter-efficient adaptation of the Safety Inspector through LoRA, while newly identified constraints are incorporated into the Constraint Space. The resulting framework integrates explicit safety knowledge representation,context-aware constraint selection, corrective safety inspection, and test-time knowledge adaptation for safety-aware robotic behavior planning.

AI.tldr: 提出以显式"约束空间"存储可复用文本安全规则的安全感知行为规划框架：将约束选择建模为任务与环境条件的适用性学习，用轻量query-conditioned双塔模型选取适用约束，并引入多模态Safety Inspector对生成的原语计划进行校验、重建完整约束集并给出纠错反馈，反馈用于测试时适配与LoRA参数高效更新。
AI.motivation: 桌面环境下的安全操作约束依赖场景上下文，且常未在指令中显式给出；仅按语义相似度检索安全规则无法保证所选约束对当前任务/场景真正适用。
AI.method: 1) 显式Constraint Space存储可复用文本安全规则；2) 约束选择由语义相似度检索改为任务-环境条件化的适用性学习，用轻量query-conditioned双塔模型预测适用约束；3) 所选约束与原任务、图像一同输入多模态行为规划器生成原语计划；4) 多模态Safety Inspector评估原语计划、重建完整适用约束集并提供纠错规划反馈；5) 经校验的反馈用于约束适用性的测试时自适应，并以LoRA对Safety Inspector做参数高效适配，新识别的约束回写Constraint Space。
AI.result: 摘要未给出量化实验结果，仅说明框架整合了显式安全知识表示、上下文感知约束选择、纠错式安全检验与测试时知识自适应四个环节。
AI.conclusion: 将安全约束从隐式检索提升为可复用、可学习适用性、可在线更新的显式知识表示，并通过闭环检验反馈实现规划器与检查器的协同改进，为桌面操作提供可解释的安全规划范式。

title: Multi-level latent-diffusion adaptation for cross-region point cloud segmentation of ancient terraces
comment: 33 pages, 6 figures
summary: Automated lidar feature detection from lidar point clouds can support archaeological surveys, but models trained in one landscape may transfer poorly to another because of differences in terrain, vegetation, acquisition characteristics, and feature morphology. We address this problem for cross-region detection of ancient terraces using transductive unsupervised domain adaptation that exploits an unlabelled target survey. We propose MELD (Multi-level Embedding-space Latent Diffusion), which trains separate diffusion denoisers on target-domain representations at four hierarchical PointNet++ feature levels. These target distribution priors are then used to refine source representations during supervised training and target representations during inference, allowing adaptation to act directly on the multi-scale features consumed by the segmentation decoder. We additionally investigate local geometric descriptors derived from K-nearest-neighbour neighbourhoods, including surface normals, slope, and aspect. MELD is evaluated bidirectionally between the Teyuna and Miraflores lidar surveys in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Colombia, against a source-only model and nine configurations of established domain adaptation approaches. MELD raises F1 over the source-only model from 0.397 to 0.459 for Teyuna-to-Miraflores transfer and from 0.557 to 0.594 in the reverse direction, achieving the highest F1 among the evaluated adaptation methods in both directions. Adding local geometry further raises F1 to 0.542 and 0.606, respectively. Multi-level ablation shows that refining all four PointNet++ levels provides the strongest performance in both directions. These results show that explicit modelling of target feature distributions in hierarchical point cloud feature space, complemented by local geometry, provides an effective route to cross-region archaeological mapping without target labels.

AI.tldr: MELD：在PointNet++四个层级特征空间上分别训练目标域潜扩散去噪器，作为目标分布先验，在训练与推理时修正源/目标表示，实现跨区域古梯田LiDAR检测的无监督域自适应。
AI.motivation: LiDAR点云自动化考古特征检测模型难以跨景观迁移，原因在于地形、植被、采集参数与遗迹形态差异；需要在无目标标签条件下实现跨区域（哥伦比亚Teyuna与Miraflores两测区）古梯田检测。
AI.method: 采用转导式无监督域自适应，利用未标注目标测区。提出MELD（Multi-level Embedding-space Latent Diffusion）：在PointNet++四个层级特征上分别训练目标域扩散去噪器，得到目标分布先验；训练时用其精修源域表示，推理时精修目标域表示，使自适应直接作用于分割解码器所消费的多尺度特征。另探索KNN邻域局部几何描述子（法向、坡度、坡向）。与仅源域模型及九种域自适应配置对比，做双向迁移实验与多层级消融。
AI.result: Teyuna→Miraflores F1由0.397升至0.459；反向由0.557升至0.594，双向均为对比方法中最高。加入局部几何后F1分别提升至0.542与0.606。四层级全精修的消融效果最强。
AI.conclusion: 在层级点云特征空间中显式建模目标分布，并结合局部几何描述子，可在无目标标签下有效完成跨区域考古制图；隐式扩散先验作用于多尺度嵌入空间是域自适应的可行路径。

title: InfiHall-Bench: A Benchmark for Hallucination Evaluation in Autoregressive Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Hallucination benchmarks for text-to-image generation are predominantly designed around diffusion models, limiting their diagnostic value for visual autoregressive (VAR) models and the development of mitigation methods. We identify two limitations in existing prompt construction paradigms: many prompts are no longer challenging for modern generators, while category-based construction relies on recurring object-attribute-relation templates and rarely tests interactions among multiple visual requirements within a single image. We introduce InfiHall-Bench, a controlled benchmark of 411 prompts constructed by systematically composing five foundational and visually verifiable skills: attribute binding, spatial relation, action relation, part consistency, and scene consistency. Each prompt covers 4.05 annotated skills on average, enabling the evaluation of hallucinations under diverse combinations of visual requirements. Using this benchmark, we find that hallucinations in VAR models exhibit a scale-wise persistence pattern: semantic errors can emerge at different autoregressive scales and are rarely corrected by subsequent fine-scale steps. Motivated by this observation, we propose Confidence-Masked Hallucination Mitigation (CMHM), which estimates the prediction confidence of target visual tokens at each autoregressive scale during teacher-forced fine-tuning. CMHM downweights reliably predicted tokens, allowing optimization to focus on uncertain predictions across scales. Experiments show that InfiHall-Bench distinguishes models that existing compositional benchmarks rate as comparable, while CMHM consistently outperforms uniform LoRA fine-tuning for VAR-based text-to-image generation.

AI.tldr: 提出文本到图像幻觉基准 InfiHall-Bench（411条提示，组合5类可验证技能），揭示VAR模型幻觉的"尺度持续性"现象，并提出置信度掩蔽微调方法CMHM。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图幻觉基准多针对扩散模型，对视觉自回归（VAR）模型诊断价值有限；且提示构造存在两问题：部分提示对现代生成器已无挑战性，类别式构造依赖反复出现的"物体-属性-关系"模板，很少测试单图内多视觉需求的组合交互。
AI.method: 构建受控基准 InfiHall-Bench：系统组合属性绑定、空间关系、动作关系、部件一致性、场景一致性五类可验证基础技能，每条提示平均标注4.05个技能。基于该基准观测到VAR幻觉在不同自回归尺度上出现且难以被后续细尺度步骤纠正，据此提出CMHM：在teacher-forced微调中估计各尺度目标视觉token的预测置信度，对高置信token降权，使优化聚焦于跨尺度的不确定预测。
AI.result: InfiHall-Bench能区分被现有组合式基准评为相当的模型；CMHM在VAR文生图任务上稳定优于uniform LoRA微调。
AI.conclusion: 多技能组合式受控基准可更敏感地诊断生成模型幻觉；利用尺度间置信度差异进行的掩蔽式微调为VAR模型幻觉缓解提供了有效手段，但其验证限于生成质量指标，未涉及具身或3D任务。

title: SWAM: Saliency-Weighted Asymmetric Merging for Efficient Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong performance on image recognition tasks, yet their quadratic self-attention complexity over input tokens creates prohibitive computational costs for practical deployment. Token reduction methods offer a practical solution by progressively reducing the token sequence during the forward pass. We propose Saliency-Weighted Asymmetric Merging (SWAM), a training-based token merging framework that extends the Bipartite Soft Matching (BSM) with two saliency-aware mechanisms. We introduce a two-step matching formulation in which cosine similarity decides candidate pairs, while a multiplicative maximum saliency penalty regulates their selection for merging. We then further use asymmetric exponential saliency-weighted aggregation, which allows more salient tokens to contribute more strongly to the merged representation. A lightweight MLP-based saliency prediction module (75k parameters per stage, 1% of backbone parameters) supervised via attention rollout is trained end-to-end jointly with a DeiT-Small backbone using a composite cross-entropy, knowledge-distillation, and saliency-alignment objective. On CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, and ImageNet-100, under a conservative schedule that reduces tokens from 196 to 100 patch tokens, with the CLS token retained throughout, 27.5% FLOPs reduction and 1.35 times speedup, SWAM matches or exceeds baseline across the reported results. Under an aggressive schedule (196 to 70 tokens with the CLS token kept throughout, 33.8% FLOPs reduction, and 1.46 times speedup), accuracy gains are achieved on ImageNet-100 (+0.23%) with minimal losses on CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet.

AI.tldr: SWAM：在BSM基础上引入显著性加权的不对称令牌合并，用注意力rollout监督的轻量MLP做显著性预测，联合蒸馏训练，在减少27.5%-33.8% FLOPs下保持或略超基线精度。
AI.motivation: ViT的自注意力复杂度随令牌数二次增长，部署代价高；现有效率方法如BSM令牌合并对所有令牌一视同仁，缺乏对重要（显著）令牌的保护与加权，易损失关键信息。
AI.method: 两步匹配：余弦相似度产生候选对，乘以最大显著性惩罚项来筛选可合并对；采用不对称指数显著性加权聚合，使高显著令牌对合并表示贡献更大；每阶段加一个75k参数（约主干1%）的MLP显著性预测模块，以attention rollout为监督信号，与DeiT-Small端到端联合训练，损失为交叉熵+知识蒸馏+显著性对齐的复合目标。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet、ImageNet-100上，保守设置（196→100令牌、保留CLS、FLOPs降27.5%、1.35倍加速）精度持平或超过基线；激进设置（196→70、FLOPs降33.8%、1.46倍加速）在ImageNet-100提升0.23%，其余两数据集仅有极小下降。
AI.conclusion: 显著性感知的不对称合并为训练型令牌压缩提供了简单有效的改进，可在明显降低计算量时基本无损精度；但仅在中小规模分类数据集上验证，未涉及检测/分割、视频或机器人感知等下游任务。

title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
comment: Ongoing Work. Homepage: this https URL
summary: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity.
