The definitive version was published in Science Robotics on 11 November 2026, DOI: this https URL

AI.tldr: 用仿真RL训练策略并零样本迁移到真机，实现5吨滑移装载机（John Deere 332G）的自主特技动作：双轮翘起、双轮平衡行驶、颠簸地形、轨迹跟踪、旋转与铲斗摆动后安全落回四轮。
AI.motivation: 重型机械（施工、采矿、物料搬运）自动化潜力大，但液压驱动含流体、柔性件与非线性延迟，动力学复杂；机器体积重量大，实机实验危险，难以试错学习。作者希望验证RL+sim-to-real能否把重型机械推到执行器极限，完成此前仅少数顶尖人类操作员在世界纪录中完成的特技动作。
AI.method: 在仿真中构建该装载机的动力学模型（含液压执行器特性），用强化学习训练特技控制策略，再将策略迁移（sim-to-real）到真实5吨级John Deere 332G滑移装载机上执行。
AI.result: 真实机器上自主完成双轮翘起与平衡、颠簸地形行驶、指定轨迹跟踪、原地旋转、铲斗前后摆动并安全落回四轮等动态特技，难度达到人类专家世界纪录水平。
AI.conclusion: 仿真RL加sim-to-real迁移可实现重型机械的动态自主控制，为重型装备行业自动化提供可行路径；亦印证高危/大惯量平台"先仿真再实机"的范式。

title: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
comment: 43 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt web-pretrained vision-language models to output robot actions, so that web knowledge carries over to physical control. In under 4 years the field has moved from RT-2, the first VLA, to open models that fine-tune on a single consumer GPU and to proprietary generalists that clean unseen homes. This survey reviews 88 works from December 2022 to October 2026, mainly on manipulation and navigation, plus humanoid control, world-action models and evaluation. We follow a VLA through its life cycle, from model design to training and deployment, along seven axes. Model design covers (a) inputs and memory, what the model observes; (b) architecture, how its pipeline is built; (c) action output, how it produces motor commands; and (d) intermediate predictions, what else it predicts, from reasoning steps to future observations. Training covers (e) pretraining data, the mix of robot, web, human and simulated data, and (f) post-training, adaptation to the target robot. Deployment covers (g) real-time execution, keeping pace with the robot. We analyse 22 models on these axes and report their training data, model size, inference speed and hardware. Three trends emerge: (i) training data has broadened, from about 10,000 hours of teleoperated robot data ($\pi_0$) to 23,000 community-collected episodes (SmolVLA) and 20,000 hours of egocentric human video (GR00T N1.7); (ii) model sizes have split: most recent models have 3-7 billion parameters, while a new group under one billion runs on consumer GPUs; and (iii) generalist VLAs are emerging that handle both manipulation and navigation, such as UniVLA and Qwen-VLA. We also compare VLAs with world-action models, which predict future observations as well as actions. We review evidence that some VLAs with near-perfect benchmark scores fail when objects or the camera move slightly, and open up further research questions.

AI.tldr: 综述文章：系统梳理2022年12月至2026年10月共88篇视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型工作，沿"模型设计—训练—部署"七轴（输入与记忆、架构、动作输出、中间预测、预训练数据、后训练、实时执行）分析22个代表性模型的训练数据、参数量、推理速度与硬件，并对比world-action models、讨论benchmark虚高的鲁棒性问题。
AI.motivation: VLA在不到4年内从RT-2发展到可在单张消费级GPU微调的开放模型与能进入未见过家庭的通用型系统，领域扩张迅速但缺乏从模型设计到训练再到部署的统一生命周期视角；同时存在"benchmark近乎满分但物体或相机轻微移动即失效"的证据，需要系统性梳理现状与研究空白。
AI.method: 文献综述，覆盖88篇工作，重点在操作与导航，兼及人形控制、world-action models与评测；按七个维度组织：(a) 输入与记忆，(b) 架构，(c) 动作输出，(d) 中间预测（推理步骤到未来观测），(e) 预训练数据混合（机器人/网络/人类/仿真），(f) 后训练与目标机器人适配，(g) 实时执行；并表格化对比22个模型的训练数据规模、模型大小、推理速度与硬件，另与WAM进行比较。
AI.result: 提炼三大趋势：(i) 训练数据持续拓宽，从约1万小时遥操作数据（π0）到2.3万社区采集episode（SmolVLA）与2万小时第一人称人类视频（GR00T N1.7）；(ii) 模型规模两极分化，近期模型多为3–7B参数，另有一批<1B模型可在消费级GPU运行；(iii) 出现同时处理操作与导航的通用型VLA（UniVLA、Qwen-VLA）。同时归纳部分VLA在物体或相机小幅变化下失效的鲁棒性证据。
AI.conclusion: VLA正沿数据规模化、模型规模分化与通用化三条路径演进，但评测可靠性不足；未来需关注跨本体数据利用、中间预测的实用价值、真实部署鲁棒性以及通用操作-导航统一架构等开放问题。

title: AI-Based Multi-View Echocardiographic Image Synthesis using Dynamic Shape Control
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Ultrasonics Symposium (IUS 2026)
summary: Although automated methods have improved echocardiographic workflows, progress remains constrained by the need for large, well-annotated datasets. As the development of clinical databases is often limited by ethical and logistical challenges, synthetic data generation has emerged as a promising alternative. However, existing approaches commonly rely on left ventricle shape-based supervision or are tailored to specific cardiac views, limiting the generation of additional standard and unconventional imaging planes and the preservation of multi-view consistency across cardiac chambers. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework for shape-controlled synthesis of multi-view echocardiographic sequences. First, multi-view cross-sections are extracted from dynamic whole-heart meshes. Ultrasound-like appearance is then introduced through a two-stage AI-based pipeline. In Stage 1, an unpaired GAN-diffusion model translates these cross-sections into realistic echocardiographic frames. As this translation is performed independently at the frame level, Stage 2 employs masked video reconstruction to improve temporal coherence and cardiac motion. Evaluation demonstrated high frame-level realism for both stages, while the integration of Stage 2 substantially improved video-level motion quality and temporal consistency. Overall, the proposed framework enables the generation of realistic multi-view echocardiographic sequences from diverse cardiac models, providing a scalable source of annotated data for dataset augmentation and the development of multi-view cardiac assessment methods.

AI.tldr: 该文提出由全心脏动态网格切面驱动的多视角超声心动图序列可控合成框架：先用非配对GAN-扩散模型做帧级真实感转换，再用掩码视频重建增强时序一致性与心脏运动。
AI.motivation: 真实标注超声数据集受伦理与流程限制难以规模化；现有合成方法多依赖左心室形状监督或局限于特定切面，难以生成多标准/非标准切面并保持跨视角一致性。
AI.method: 从动态全心脏网格提取多视角切面；两阶段AI管线：Stage 1用非配对GAN-扩散模型将切面翻译为真实超声帧；Stage 2用掩码视频重建（masked video reconstruction）提升时序连贯性与心脏运动保真度。
AI.result: 两阶段在帧级真实感上均表现良好；引入Stage 2后视频级运动质量与时序一致性显著提升。评估为定量指标，未涉及临床端任务验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可由多样心脏模型生成真实感多视角超声序列，为数据集增广与多视角心脏评估方法开发提供可扩展的标注数据来源。

title: CS-MPC: Contraction-Certified Sampling-Based MPC for Nonlinear Systems Under Uncertainty
summary: We present contraction-certified sampling-based model predictive control (CS-MPC) for tracking and safety of nonlinear robotic systems under parametric uncertainty, disturbances, and safety constraints that are revealed online. CS-MPC uses a contraction-certified tracking feedback inside every sampled rollout, which concentrates the rollouts around the reference, and an execution layer that verifies the applied input using a quantile-tightened discrete-time control barrier function condition. We derive a verification procedure for nonlinear contraction of the feedback-closed dynamics, and we prove a finite-sample stochastic stability bound and a mission-level probabilistic safety guarantee. We validate CS-MPC in simulation on a rover, a quadrotor, and an asteroid landing. When compared with standard model predictive path integral (MPPI) control, CS-MPC attains the same tracking error with 7 to 20 times fewer rollouts for the rover, and a 2 to 4 times lower tracking error for the quadrotor, with no safety violations in 200 Monte Carlo missions.

AI.tldr: CS-MPC：在每次采样 rollout 内嵌收缩认证跟踪反馈，使采样集中在参考附近，并用分位数收紧的离散时间 CBF 条件做执行层验证；证明有限样本随机稳定性与任务级概率安全。
AI.motivation: 非线性机器人系统在参数不确定性、扰动与在线才暴露的安全约束下，标准 MPPI 类采样 MPC 需要大量 rollout 才能压住跟踪误差，且缺乏可验证的安全保证。
AI.method: 1) 每个采样 rollout 内使用收缩认证（contraction-certified）跟踪反馈，使轨迹贴近参考；2) 执行层以分位数收紧的离散时间 CBF 条件校验实际施加的输入；3) 给出闭环非线性收缩性验证流程、有限样本随机稳定性界与任务级概率安全保证。
AI.result: 仿真中在 rover、四旋翼、小行星着陆三任务验证：对比标准 MPPI，rover 同跟踪误差下 rollout 数少 7–20 倍，四旋翼跟踪误差低 2–4 倍；200 次 Monte Carlo 任务无安全违规。
AI.conclusion: 收缩反馈与 CBF 执行层结合可显著提升采样 MPC 的样本效率并提供可证安全，但证据目前仅为仿真，缺硬件部署与真实扰动验证。

title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
summary: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.

AI.tldr: Gamer：端到端通用智能体框架，融合感知、记忆管理与多步推理，用海量键鼠轨迹做持续预训练+稀疏思考指令微调+多轮强化学习，配合云边推理引擎在2D/3D游戏中实时长程交互。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体难以在复杂交互环境中完成长程任务，且缺乏统一支持2D图形界面与3D仿真世界的训练/部署管线；作者假设即使是重复性键鼠轨迹，也能通过规模化的数据与学习算法带来显著能力提升，并可作为通向跨数字与物理世界通用智能体的路径。
AI.method: 1）从数万小时设备级键鼠交互轨迹（涵盖模拟游戏与具身环境）构建数据集做持续预训练，学习物理与虚拟域的环境动力学；2）稀疏思考（sparse-thinking）指令微调，压缩冗余计算但保留复杂决策推理；3）采用稳定的多轮强化学习方法训练长程策略，针对性处理有限上下文窗口、rollout误差累积与稀疏奖励；4）云边推理引擎支持多环境并发、无界上下文执行与低在线延迟。
AI.result: 在多个高难度3D开放世界游戏中表现出良好泛化与运行效率，接近熟练玩家水平；在多种传统2D游戏基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 重复性键鼠轨迹配合数据与算法规模化即可支撑复杂技能学习，尤其在兼具物理与数字属性的环境中更稳定；该路线为跨数字与物理世界的通用智能体提供了可行方向。整体偏"游戏/界面通用智能体"，与具身操作、3D重建等核心方向仅为邻近，缺少真实机器人或物理世界部署证据。

title: CoPre-MoE: Consolidating and Preserving MoE for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal continual instruction tuning requires multimodal large language models to sequentially acquire new capabilities without catastrophic forgetting. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures offer a promising way to mitigate task interference through expert specialization and combination. However, while existing MoE-based methods avoid overwriting shared parameters by allocating separate experts for each task, this progressive expansion incurs severe cross-task redundancy and linear parameter growth. Specifically, experts across tasks often learn overlapping functions alongside task-specific capabilities. For instance, ScienceQA and TextVQA both locate relevant image regions. To curb parameter redundancy without inducing forgetting, we propose Consolidating and Preserving MoE (CoPre-MoE). For each incoming task, CoPre-MoE first learns task-specific MoE to capture specialized capabilities. To eliminate redundancy and reduce parameter growth across tasks, we design a shared-and-private expert architecture. Specifically, we first evaluate functional overlap to selectively consolidate overlapping experts across tasks into a fixed-capacity generic expert pool. We then factorize the remaining task-specific experts into shared projection bases and compact task-specific cores within a private expert pool. To mitigate forgetting, we construct the router by pairing each expert with learnable retrieval keys, where historical keys remain frozen during continual updates while newly added keys are regularized with an orthogonality penalty. At inference, input-dependent routing dynamically combines both pools without test-time task labels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoPre-MoE achieves superior performance while substantially reducing parameter overhead.

AI.tldr: CoPre-MoE：面向多模态持续指令微调，将跨任务功能重叠的专家合并进固定容量通用专家池，其余私有专家分解为共享投影基+紧凑任务核，并用冻结检索键+正交正则的路由实现无任务标签的动态组合，显著降低参数增长且缓解遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有 MoE 持续微调方法为每任务分配独立专家以避免覆盖共享参数，但导致跨任务功能冗余（如 ScienceQA 与 TextVQA 均需定位相关图像区域）与线性参数膨胀，需在抑制冗余的同时不引发灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 对新任务先学习任务专属 MoE；随后评估功能重叠，将重叠专家选择性合并为固定容量通用专家池；剩余任务专属专家分解为共享投影基与紧凑任务专属核，存于私有专家池；路由为每个专家配对可学习检索键，历史键冻结、新键加正交惩罚，推理时依输入动态组合两池，无需测试时任务标签。
AI.result: 大量实验显示 CoPre-MoE 性能优于基线，并大幅降低参数开销。
AI.conclusion: 共享-私有专家架构可有效遏制 MoE 持续指令微调中的参数冗余，配合冻结键+正交正则路由实现抗遗忘的持续能力获取。

title: The State Is Not the Bottleneck: A Paged-State Gated-DeltaNet Tile on a Tri-Mode Multicast Mesh, Bit-Exact from RTL to Silicon
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. The technical supplement is included as an ancillary file. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Linear-attention language models replace a growing key-value cache with a recurrent state of fixed size. On an edge FPGA, this state can exceed the on-chip memory and must be paged to external memory. This paper asks whether such paging dominates the cost of decoding (generating tokens). We built a hardware tile that computes one complete layer of a custom 369-million-parameter hybrid Gated DeltaNet model on an Agilex 5 FPGA and pages its recurrent state. The model state needs 6.2 MiB, whereas the device has 0.87 MiB of block memory. Paging adds 26.0 MB of memory traffic per decoded token, at most 11.2 percent of the calculated total. On the board at 75 MHz, with synthetic weights, one token takes 11.15 ms in this layer. The matrix-vector products with the weights take about 62 percent of this time and the state phase, including the paging, 13 percent. The tile is one node of a multicast mesh of tri-mode processing elements. We measure the error of the fixed-point arithmetic against floating point and check that the hardware agrees bit for bit with a fixed-point reference. In simulation, the state logic agrees with the reference on all 18 recurrent layers. On the board, six builds pass all 30 runs of 64 tokens and two runs of 1,024 tokens. For this model and memory interface, the delivery of the weights limits the decoding performance, and the recurrent state does not. State paging is therefore practical for such a model on an edge FPGA.

AI.tldr: 在 Agilex 5 边缘 FPGA 上实现 369M 参数混合 Gated DeltaNet 的单层硬件 tile，并对 6.2 MiB 循环状态进行外存分页，测得每 token 分页流量 26.0 MB（≤11.2% 总流量）；板上 75 MHz 单层 11.15 ms，权重矩阵向量乘占 62%，状态相（含分页）仅 13%。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力模型用固定大小循环状态替代增长的 KV 缓存，但在边缘 FPGA 上该状态超出片上内存，必须分页到外部存储。作者追问：这类分页开销是否会主导解码成本，从而决定线性注意力在边缘加速器上的可行性。
AI.method: 设计单层硬件 tile 计算自定义 369M 参数混合 Gated DeltaNet 的一整层并分页循环状态；tile 为三模处理单元多播 mesh 的一个节点；采用定点运算并与浮点及定点参考逐位比对，仿真验证全部 18 个循环层，板上 6 次构建覆盖 30 次 64 token 与 2 次 1024 token 运行。
AI.result: 状态 6.2 MiB vs 片上 0.87 MiB block memory；每 token 分页流量 26.0 MB，占计算总流量至多 11.2%；75 MHz 合成权重下单层 11.15 ms，权重 MV 约 62%，状态相（含分页）13%；仿真 18 层全部一致，板上运行全部通过。
AI.conclusion: 在该模型与内存接口下，解码瓶颈是权重搬运而非循环状态，状态分页在边缘 FPGA 上具有实用性；结论依赖合成权重与单层实现，端到端多节点与真实权重下的带宽竞争仍需验证。

title: Do Underwater Image Quality Metrics Agree with Human Perception? A Benchmark with Human Choices, Simple Edits and Generative Drift
comment: Accepted at the 6th WVAQ Workshop, WACV 2027. 18 pages including appendix
summary: Underwater image enhancement is challenging to evaluate due to the lack of clean reference images, so researchers rely on no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) metrics. However, it remains unclear whether these metrics agree with human judgments. We evaluate 73 handcrafted underwater, learned underwater, vision-language and general-purpose metrics against human preferences on five references: four published opinion-score sets and a new paired-comparison study. For each metric, we measure how often it selects the same image as people when comparing versions of the same scene. We further test whether simple image edits and small adversarial perturbations raise metric scores above the enhancement people preferred, and whether scores decrease as repeated generative edits add noise. Our results show that no metric consistently matches human preferences. The best worst-case Cohen's kappa over the five references is only 0.23 (Q-Align), while two raters in our study agree with a median kappa of 0.41. The widely used UCIQE often favors edits that people reject. On a Nano Banana Pro replica chain that should leave the image unchanged, only 22 of 73 scores decrease at every checkpoint, while noise grows by 2.5 times. We also introduce TrustUIQA, a benchmark that combines the human references, our study choices, the edited, attacked and generated images, and the scores of every metric on every image. The code is available at this https URL and TrustUIQA at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评测了73种水下图像增强质量评价指标（手工、学习型、视觉语言模型、通用型）与人类偏好的一致性，发现无一指标能稳定匹配人判，并发布TrustUIQA基准。
AI.motivation: 水下图像增强缺乏干净参考图，学界依赖无参考图像质量评价（NR-IQA）指标，但这些指标是否与人类判断一致尚不清楚；若指标可被简单编辑或对抗扰动欺骗，基于其得出的"提升"结论便不可靠。
AI.method: 在5个人类参考（4个已发表主观评分集+1个新配对比较研究）上评测73种指标：测量同一场景版本比较中指标选图与人类选图的一致率（最差情形Cohen's kappa）；测试简单图像编辑与小幅对抗扰动能否把指标分数抬高到超过人类偏好的增强结果之上；并检验重复生成式编辑累积噪声时分数是否下降（Nano Banana Pro 复制链）。
AI.result: 无指标能一致匹配人类偏好：5个参考上最差情形kappa最高仅0.23（Q-Align），而本研究两名标注者之间中位kappa为0.41。常用UCIQE常偏好人类拒绝的编辑。在理论上应保持图像不变的生成复制链上，73个分数中仅22个在每个检查点均下降，而噪声增大2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 现有水下NR-IQA指标作为增强质量的代理判据不可靠，易被扰动与生成伪影欺骗；作者发布TrustUIQA基准（含人类参考、配对选择、编辑/攻击/生成图像及全部指标分数）以支撑更严谨的评测。

title: Toward On-Device Markerless 6DoF Tracking of a Physical Manipulative on a Mixed-Reality Headset: A Preliminary Study
summary: AR-Classroom uses physical models and virtual overlays to help learners explore spatial transformations. To align these overlays on a standalone headset, we developed a markerless six-degree-of-freedom(6DoF) tracker for a LEGO airplane on the Meta Quest 3. A compact YOLO model trained on synthetic Unity renders predicts 20 keypoints from dynamic RGB crops resized to 128 by 128 pixels. A perspective-n-point solver estimates the airplane's pose from these predictions and the corresponding 3D landmarks. In a paired evaluation on 1,000 synthetic validation images, cropping guided by ground-truth boxes increased the detection rate on annotated images from 32.5 to 46.2 percent. Mean keypoint F1 increased from 42.9 to 44.6 percent, with lower keypoint precision in the cropped view. In preliminary headset tests, 2 Hz was the highest tested tracking target at which the application maintained approximately 72 frames per second. A headset demonstration illustrates virtual overlay alignment with the physical airplane before and after a manual rotation. Quantitative 6DoF pose accuracy on real headset footage will be measured in future work.

AI.tldr: 在 Meta Quest 3 上为非标记 6DoF 追踪 LEGO 飞机：合成数据训练的紧凑 YOLO 从动态 RGB 裁剪（128×128）预测 20 个关键点，PnP 求解位姿，用于 AR 物理-虚拟叠加对齐。
AI.motivation: AR-Classroom 需用物理模型 + 虚拟叠加帮助学习者探索空间变换，但在独立头显上要把叠加层与真实物体对齐，缺乏可用的无标记 6DoF 追踪方案。
AI.method: Unity 合成渲染数据训练紧凑 YOLO 关键点回归器（20 关键点，输入 128×128 动态 RGB 裁剪），配合 PnP 求解器结合 3D 地标估计位姿；在 1000 张合成验证图上做配对评估（GT 框引导裁剪 vs 非裁剪），并在 Quest 3 上做初步实时测试。
AI.result: GT 框引导裁剪使标注图像检测率从 32.5% 提升至 46.2%，关键点平均 F1 从 42.9% 提升至 44.6%（但裁剪视图关键点精度下降）；头显上 2 Hz 追踪目标下维持约 72 FPS；给出旋转前后叠加对齐的演示。真实头显数据的定量 6DoF 精度留待后续。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了一个轻量、纯合成数据驱动的头显端无标记 6DoF 追踪原型，可行性初显，但绝对精度偏低（检测率<50%）且缺失真实场景定量位姿评估，尚属工程验证阶段。

title: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
comment: Work in process, website: \url{ this https URL }
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens for parallel verification by a target model. Diffusion drafters such as DFlash propose an entire token block in a single forward pass, but mainly focus on text-only tasks, leaving multimodal drafting underexplored. To study this setting, we first introduce a metric of token-level visual dependence based on the KL divergence between next-token distributions with and without visual input. We find that acceptance rates decrease from 46% in the lowest visual-dependence quartile to 22% in the highest, with this disparity persisting after multimodal training. Motivated by this observation, we propose MMFlash, a simple and effective framework that adaptively upweights visually dependent tokens that the drafter predicts poorly. For long video inputs, MMFlash further employs sparse attention to reduce redundant attention computation and improve drafting quality. Across various multimodal benchmarks, MMFlash achieves lossless decoding speedups of up to $3.58\times$, outperforming EAGLE-3 and DFlash by up to 195.4% and 17.1%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出MMFlash：一种多模态扩散草稿器投机解码框架。作者先用基于KL散度的token级视觉依赖度量，发现视觉依赖越高接受率越低（46%→22%），据此自适应加权高视觉依赖token，并对长视频用稀疏注意力降开销；多模态基准上无损加速最高3.58×，优于EAGLE-3和DFlash。
AI.motivation: 扩散式草稿器（如DFlash）能一次前向生成整块token，但主要针对纯文本任务，多模态投机解码的草稿质量与接受率问题尚未被系统研究。作者需要一个量化指标解释多模态场景下接受率下降的成因。
AI.method: 1）定义token级视觉依赖度：比较有/无视觉输入时下一token分布的KL散度；2）按依赖度分位数统计接受率；3）MMFlash框架：对草稿器预测差且视觉依赖高的token自适应上调权重（自适应加权训练/验证目标）；4）长视频输入下引入稀疏注意力，降低冗余注意力计算并提升草稿质量；5）与EAGLE-3、DFlash对比的多模态基准加速实验。
AI.result: 接受率从最低视觉依赖四分位的46%降至最高四分位的22%，且多模态训练后差距仍存在；MMFlash在多个多模态基准上实现最高3.58×无损解码加速，相对EAGLE-3、DFlash分别最高提升195.4%和17.1%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉依赖是制约多模态投机解码接受率的关键因素；通过视觉依赖感知的token加权与长视频稀疏注意力，可在不损精度前提下显著加速多模态生成，为多模态推理加速提供了一套诊断指标与轻量有效方案。

title: From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication in Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems, Volume 10 (2027)
summary: AI-enabled remote patient monitoring is evolving beyond passive data collection toward agentic AI systems that interpret patient states, coordinate care, and initiate action across domestic and clinical settings. This structured scoping review finds that mature agentic care has not yet emerged: Most systems remain human led, while stronger decision-action coupling and embodied AI remain largely confined to prototypes and pilots. Healthcare robotics makes the transition from monitoring to action especially visible by translating AI-generated recommendations and decisions into speech, movement, prompting, physical assistance, escalation, and care coordination, making embodiment, clinical integration, human oversight, and governance fundamental design requirements. Further progress requires safe and interoperable care architectures in which intelligent components operate through clinically validated and accountable workflows. We propose agentic robotics as a future direction for supervised systems embedded in the care ecosystem, connecting AI agents and robots with clinicians, caregivers, and patients through auditable workflows that can be interrupted and remain subject to human oversight and explicit AI governance.

AI.tldr: A structured scoping review of AI-enabled remote patient monitoring finds that mature agentic care has not yet emerged; proposes "agentic robotics" as a future direction built on supervised, auditable, interruptible care workflows.
AI.motivation: Remote patient monitoring has evolved from passive sensing to agentic AI that interprets states and initiates action; however, embodiment, clinical integration, human oversight and governance remain underdeveloped, motivating a systematic mapping of the field and a design agenda.
AI.method: Structured scoping review of AI-enabled remote patient monitoring and healthcare robotics, analyzing systems along dimensions of decision–action coupling, embodiment, clinical integration, human oversight, and governance; no new system or empirical method is proposed.
AI.result: Most reviewed systems remain human-led with weak decision–action coupling; strong coupling and embodied AI are confined to prototypes and pilot studies, so mature agentic care is not yet realized.
AI.conclusion: Progress requires safe, interoperable care architectures with clinically validated and accountable workflows; the paper proposes agentic robotics—supervised robots/agents connected to clinicians, caregivers and patients via auditable, interruptible workflows under explicit AI governance.

title: When Will You Hand It Over? A Hidden Start Delay Makes Self-Play Handover Robust to Unfamiliar Partners
comment: CoRL 2026, Human-Centered Robot Learning and Interaction (HumanRLI) Workshop. Code: this https URL
summary: Cooperative self-play can teach a humanoid to receive an object without any human data, but the partner it meets after training is never the one it trained with; we show that a fluent self-play handover policy breaks with unfamiliar partners, identify the main cause, and repair it. In a physics-based parcel handover between a Unitree G1 and a learned giver, both trained by alternating PPO self-play, the receiver completes 95% and 90% of handovers with its own partner (two training seeds) but only 31% with scripted partners it has never met. Paired interventions isolate the cause: under a shared reward the learned giver always starts its offer at once, so the receiver learns a single rendezvous, and delaying its own partner by one second cuts success from 95% to 6% (87% to 34% in the second seed). We introduce hidden start-delay randomisation (HSD), a one-line rule on the learned partner that the receiver never observes. After 300 further updates, success with unseen scripted partners rises from 31% to 80% in both seeds, against 35--41% for a budget-matched control. The gain holds on a fresh scenario seed, on eleven held-out partner conditions and on partners that start later than any training delay; it cuts high-force contact three- to five-fold and needs no retraining of the partner.

AI.tldr: 人形机器人自博弈递物策略在换伙伴后严重失效，作者用配对干预定位到原因是学习型给予者固定起始时机使接收者过拟合单一会合点，提出隐藏起始延迟随机化（HSD）一行规则，使未见伙伴成功率31%→80%。
AI.motivation: 自博弈(cooperative self-play)可在无人类数据下训练人形递物策略，但训练伙伴与测试伙伴必然不一致；作者要弄清这种"伙伴泛化"失败的根因并给出低成本的修复手段，而非整体重训。
AI.method: 在物理仿真中搭建 Unitree G1 接收者与学习型给予者的包裹递接任务，交替 PPO 自博弈训练。用配对干预（共享奖励下给予者立即发起、人为延迟1秒）做因果归因；随后提出 HSD：在学习型给予者的起始时刻加隐藏随机延迟，接收者观测不到该延迟，仅需在接收侧再训练 300 次更新，代价匹配对照组用于排除单纯增加训练预算的效应。
AI.result: 同伙伴成功率95%/90%（两个种子），未见脚本伙伴仅31%；给自己伙伴加1秒延迟降至6%（第二种子87%→34%）。HSD后未见伙伴成功率两个种子均升至80%，预算匹配对照仅35–41%；在新场景种子、11种留出伙伴条件、超出训练延迟范围的后启动伙伴上均保持增益，高力接触减少3–5倍，且无需重训给予者。
AI.conclusion: 自博弈策略失效的主因是对手行为时序的分布过窄而非策略能力不足；对对手施加隐藏的时序随机化即可显著提升跨伙伴鲁棒性，是一种只需一行规则的即插即用正则化，可推广到其他需与人协作的接触丰富任务。

title: Toward Resilient Self-Driving Laboratories through Telerobotic Interventions
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) accelerate scientific research by integrating robotics, automated experimentation, and machine learning to execute experiments autonomously. Biology and chemistry have adopted these systems. However, increasing SDL complexity heightens susceptibility to unexpected faults in automated workflows, highlighting the need for efficient recovery mechanisms. In this study, we investigate telerobotic interventions to enhance SDL resilience against unexpected failures. We developed a teleoperation interface enabling human operators to resolve disruptions during automated tasks. The interface enables precise control of a six-degree-of-freedom (DOF) robotic arm (UR3e) using a 3D mouse (3Dconnexion SpaceMouse Pro). Two velocity-based controller strategies were evaluated: (i) a coupled mode mapping all six DOFs to the 3D mouse's central knob and (ii) a decoupled mode separating translational and rotational motions. To evaluate the framework, teleoperators intervened across three SDL fault scenarios. In the first study, comparative trials showed that the decoupled controller was associated with shorter completion times and reduced rotational motion. In a second study, teleoperators performed an aiming task with and without reference-path guidance. Users were more target-driven and risk-tolerant without guidance but showed behavioral differences under different guidance strategies. These findings suggest that controller configuration and reference-path design influence operator performance during SDL fault recovery, informing teleoperation interface optimization. This work demonstrates the potential feasibility of teleoperation as a human-in-the-loop recovery mechanism for SDL workflows, combining robotic precision with human adaptability and problem-solving. These findings also provide a foundation for future studies in shared autonomy and semi-autonomous intervention.

AI.tldr: 提出遥操作干预接口，用3D鼠标（SpaceMouse Pro）控制UR3e六自由度机械臂，对比耦合与解耦两种速度控制器及有无参考路径引导对自驱动实验室（SDL）故障恢复任务中人机操作表现的影响。
AI.motivation: 自驱动实验室（SDL）集成机器人、自动化实验与机器学习实现自主实验，但复杂度提升使其更易在自动化流程中出现意外故障，需要高效的人机协同恢复机制；本文探索以遥操作干预提升SDL韧性。
AI.method: 开发遥操作界面，用3Dconnexion SpaceMouse Pro精准控制UR3e六自由度机械臂；设计两种基于速度的控制器：耦合模式（六自由度全部映射到中央拨杆）与解耦模式（平移与旋转分离）；并在三个SDL故障场景下开展遥操作者干预实验，另设瞄准任务对比有无参考路径引导的表现。
AI.result: 对比试验显示解耦控制器完成时间更短、旋转运动更少；无引导时用户更目标驱动、风险容忍度更高，不同引导策略下行为存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 控制器配置与参考路径设计影响SDL故障恢复中的操作者表现，可指导遥操作界面优化；验证了遥操作作为人在回路恢复机制的可行性，将机器人精度与人类适应性结合，并为共享自主与半自主干预研究奠定基础。

title: In Situ Monitoring and Predictive Modeling of Harmful Algal Blooms with Autonomous Surface Vehicles
summary: Harmful Algal Blooms (HABs) pose significant environmental, economic, and public-health challenges in coastal and inland water bodies, creating a need for scalable methods to collect spatially distributed water-quality data. This paper presents an autonomous surface vessel-based sensing system for in-situ water-quality monitoring related to harmful algal bloom detection. The system integrates a BlueBoat Autonomous Surface Vessel (ASV), a motorized winch for depth-controlled sonde deployment, a multiparameter water-quality sonde, side-scan sonar, and an event-camera payload. Autonomous waypoint missions were used to collect measurements across selected sampling regions and multiple depths, enabling both horizontal and vertical characterization of environmental conditions. Field deployments were conducted in Lake Pontchartrain, Louisiana, with additional measurements collected in False River, Louisiana to increase dataset diversity. The collected measurements included algal pigment indicators, nutrient concentration, turbidity, temperature, and other water-quality parameters relevant to bloom formation. In addition, complementary sonar and event-camera data were collected during vehicle operation to provide contextual environmental information. A machine-learning classification approach was also evaluated using the collected water-quality measurements to support HAB and non-HAB classification. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using a modular ASV platform for repeatable, multi-modal water-quality data collection and support future development of autonomous monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化无人水面艇（BlueBoat ASV）水质监测平台，集成绞车深度控制、多参数水质仪、侧扫声呐与事件相机，实现水平/垂直空间分布的水华（HAB）相关数据自主采集，并尝试用机器学习进行HAB/非HAB分类。
AI.motivation: 有害藻华（HAB）对沿海与内陆水体造成环境、经济和公共健康风险，亟需可扩展的、能获取空间分布式水质数据的方法；传统人工采样覆盖有限、成本高。
AI.method: 硬件层面：BlueBoat ASV + 电机绞车（深度可控投放多参数水质探头）+ 侧扫声呐 + 事件相机载荷；自主航点任务在选定区域与多个深度采集数据。在路易斯安那州Lake Pontchartrain开展现场部署，并在False River补充测量以增加数据多样性。数据包括藻类色素指标、营养盐、浊度、温度等；并基于采集的水质测量评估机器学习分类器用于HAB/非HAB判别。
AI.result: 完成多次现场部署，获得水平与垂直剖面的多模态水质数据；可行性验证表明模块化ASV平台可实现可重复的多模态水质采集；机器学习分类在水质指标上完成初步评估（摘要未给出量化精度）。
AI.conclusion: 验证了模块化ASV平台用于可重复、多模态水质数据采集的可行性，为后续自主监测系统（含自动HAB检测）奠定基础；当前工作以系统集成与数据采集为主，自主决策与定量性能评估仍有待推进。

title: Disturbance-Aware Informative Planning in Spatiotemporal Environments
comment: Submitted to Learning for Dynamics and Control Conference 2027. Project website: this https URL
summary: Autonomous robots are widely used for persistent monitoring of spatiotemporal environments, where quantities of interest (QoI) change across space and time and require repeated measurements. In practice, robot motion can be affected by external disturbances that vary across the environment. When such external disturbances are not considered in trajectory optimization, it can lead to inaccurate predictions of robot motion and, consequently, the information acquired about the QoI during execution. However, estimating disturbances throughout the environment can be inefficient, as disturbances in regions with little overlap with monitoring trajectories have limited impact on monitoring performance. We therefore propose a two-stage informative planning framework for unknown, spatially varying but time-invariant disturbances, combining informed disturbance sampling with disturbance-aware trajectory optimization. First, we identify where QoI measurements are needed and generate alternative paths to these locations using the environment geometry. We then prioritize disturbance measurements based on their expected reduction of disturbance uncertainty along these paths. Second, rather than optimizing information acquisition based on nominal robot motion, we incorporate the learned disturbance belief into trajectory optimization to account for its effects on robot motion and information acquisition. Across four simulation scenarios, the proposed method reduces disturbance-learning time by 25.0--52.3 percent compared with environment-wide estimation and identifies paths that appear costly under nominal dynamics but become preferable when disturbances are considered.

AI.tldr: 针对未知、空间变化但时间不变的外扰，提出两阶段信息规划框架：先用几何生成候选监测路径并按沿路径扰动不确定性下降最大化采样扰动，再将扰动信念嵌入轨迹优化，实现扰动感知的信息采集。
AI.motivation: 机器人对时空环境做持续监测时，外扰会影响运动，导致名义运动模型下的轨迹与信息量预测失准；但全域估计扰动代价高，且与监测轨迹重叠少的区域扰动影响有限，需按需采样。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：（1）识别需测量的QoI位置并用环境几何生成候选路径，按沿这些路径的期望扰动不确定性削减来优先采样扰动；（2）将学习到的扰动信念纳入轨迹优化，替代名义动力学以计入扰动对运动与信息获取的影响。
AI.result: 四个仿真场景中，相比全域扰动估计，扰动学习时间减少25.0–52.3%；并识别出在名义动力学下看似代价高、但考虑扰动后更优的路径。
AI.conclusion: 按轨迹相关性的主动扰动采样结合扰动感知轨迹优化，可显著降低扰动学习成本并改变路径取舍；方法局限于时不变扰动且仅在仿真中验证。

title: StreamEmbed: Real-Time Indexing from Pixels for Screenshot Retrieval
summary: Screen history can serve as searchable visual memory for people and agents, but unlike an offline corpus, it must be encoded and indexed as each screenshot arrives. OCR-based indexing is fast but loses visual information; visual encoding takes over two seconds. Yet screens change incrementally: most pixels repeat within and across screenshots. This raises a question: do visual encoders need to recompute their representations from scratch for every new screenshot? We present StreamEmbed, a system for incremental visual embedding that exploits this redundancy. Guided solely by pixel differences, it combines spatial token pruning, which skips blocks that repeat a neighbor, with temporal KV reuse, which reuses cached keys and values for blocks unchanged across screenshots. A small learned adapter compensates for pruning and reuse to preserve fidelity to full-screenshot embeddings. On ScreenMemEval, our benchmark of 10,426 questions over 184 hours of screen histories from two humans and a computer-use agent, StreamEmbed sets a new accuracy-latency Pareto frontier on an M2 Pro GPU: it encodes up to 3.7x faster than full-screenshot encoding without sacrificing accuracy and improves accuracy over OCR-based indexing by up to 6.3 Recall@10 points at matched latency. A memory-efficient vector index stores a simulated year of screenshots in 0.13 GB of RAM. Together, these results make real-time indexing of screen history in its native visual form practical, laying a foundation for fully local visual assistants.

AI.tldr: StreamEmbed 利用屏幕截图间的像素冗余，通过空间 token 剪枝与时间 KV 复用实现增量式视觉嵌入，编码速度最高 3.7×，同时保持全图嵌入的检索精度。
AI.motivation: 屏幕历史可作为可检索的视觉记忆，但需逐帧在线编码索引：OCR 索引快却丢失视觉信息，完整视觉编码每帧超过 2 秒。核心观察是屏幕内容变化是增量的，大部分像素在帧内与帧间重复，故无需对每帧从头重算视觉表示。
AI.method: 仅由像素差分驱动：空间 token 剪枝跳过与邻居重复的块；时间维度复用未变化块的 KV 缓存；并用小型学习适配器补偿剪枝与复用带来的偏差，使嵌入逼近全图嵌入。附带内存高效的向量索引。
AI.result: 在 ScreenMemEval（184 小时屏幕历史、10,426 问，来自两名用户与一个计算机使用智能体）上，于 M2 Pro GPU 建立新的精度-延迟 Pareto 前沿：最高快 3.7× 且精度不降；同延迟下较 OCR 索引 Recall@10 高至 6.3 点；模拟一年截图仅占 0.13 GB 内存。
AI.conclusion: 证明屏幕历史的原生视觉实时索引可行，为完全本地化的视觉助手奠定基础。方法属通用增量视觉编码/智能体记忆系统，非具身或 3D 核心方向，但含具体方法、系统级基准与实时性证据。

title: Box-conditional Hypothesis Testing for Out-of-Distribution Object Detection
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 13 tables
summary: Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) objects is essential for ensuring the reliability and safety of object detectors in real-world deployment. We treat the decision on a detected box as a hypothesis test with the null hypothesis that the box covers an object of an in-distribution (ID) class. The null distribution changes with the size of the box and its contact with the image border, and the detector observes both. The test can therefore rank a box only against ID boxes of the same size and border contact, which gives a distribution-free bound on the false-alarm rate for each of them and uncovers the separation that one null distribution hides. The power of the test also rests on the layer it reads. Layers built only for the ID classes have no reason to keep what sets an unknown object apart, so the test reads the features before them. We propose \textbf{PLUM}, a training-free score that pools the last backbone stage inside the box and ranks its distance to the ID classes among ID boxes of the same size and border contact. On the standard benchmark, PLUM reaches the highest AUROC among the compared methods without external models, with 91.5 and 94.5 on PASCAL-VOC and 95.1 and 97.5 on BDD100K. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: PLUM：将检测框视为假设检验，按框尺寸与边界接触分层排序，在最后一层主干特征上做无训练 OOD 打分，VOC/BDD100K 上取得最高 AUROC。
AI.motivation: 目标检测器部署需要检测分布外物体以保证可靠性；作者观察到 ID 框的零分布随框尺寸与贴边情况变化，混合后掩盖了可分性，且仅针对 ID 类训练的层不利于保留未知物体的判别信息。
AI.method: 把每个检测框的判定建模为假设检验（零假设为框内为 ID 类物体）；对框尺寸×边界接触进行分层，在同类子集内排序距离，从而给出分布无关的虚警率上界；打分读取主干最后一层特征（ID 分类头之前），进行池化并计算到 ID 类的距离，方法无需训练、无需外部模型。
AI.result: PASCAL-VOC 上 AUROC 达 91.5 与 94.5，BDD100K 上达 95.1 与 97.5，在无外部模型的对比方法中最高。
AI.conclusion: 条件化（分层）的零分布是提升 OOD 检测的有效手段，且选层很关键；无训练打分即可显著改善目标检测器的不确定性判别。

title: EventSpikeSeg: Memory-Aware Mixed-Signal Architecture for Event-Camera Spiking Segmentation
summary: Event-camera segmentation requires persistent neural state despite sparse input events, making memory organization a central constraint on embedded implementation. We present EventSpikeSeg, a mixed-signal architecture combining resident capacitor memory with shared analog processing in GF180MCU 180-nm CMOS. Its 25-population spiking encoder-decoder has 143,824 synaptic weights but requires 30,976,000 membrane states at 440 x 640 resolution. The mapping specifies chronological 5-ms model updates, digital event/address services and 64-state capacitor banks. Characterization covers 22 module families and 74 operating points, distinguishing transistor simulations from digital-library estimates. Nominal results include 41.711 microwatts biased neuron-core power, 3.338-pJ positive terminal energy for a 1.4-microsecond cell read, and 0.531-mV selected-state drift over a 5-ms extracted-tile hold. Commit and coupling errors are reported separately. The software checkpoint records 27.976% mean intersection-over-union on a held-out six-class DSEC split; this is not hardware accuracy. Component layouts and simulation evidence quantify local implementation costs and expose storage replication and service scheduling as scaling constraints. A detailed SPICE-calibrated behavioral forward simulation of one full-resolution DSEC frame achieves 24.26% mean intersection-over-union, versus 26.22% for the matched PyTorch reference, using a compact 5-fF bank variant and external count/voltage calibration. Physical full-network operation, system energy and mismatch robustness remain unverified.

AI.tldr: EventSpikeSeg：GF180MCU 180nm 混合信号脉冲神经网络事件相机分割芯片架构，以电容驻留存储+共享模拟处理承载 3097.6 万膜电位状态，给出模块级功耗/能量/漂移表征与 SPICE 标定行为仿真（24.26% mIoU vs PyTorch 26.22%）。
AI.motivation: 事件相机分割需在稀疏事件输入下维持持久神经状态，内存组织成为嵌入式实现的核心瓶颈；论文旨在量化在混合信号 CMOS 中承载大规模脉冲网络状态的可行性与局部代价。
AI.method: 基于 GF180MCU 180 nm 的混合信号架构：25 种群脉冲编解码器、143,824 突触权重、440×640 分辨率下 30,976,000 膜状态；采用常驻电容存储 + 共享模拟计算，5 ms 时序模型更新、数字事件/地址服务、64 状态电容组；覆盖 22 个模块族、74 个工作点的表征，区分晶体管级仿真与数字库估算；并用紧凑 5 fF 电容组变体做 SPICE 标定的全分辨率单帧行为前向仿真。
AI.result: 标称神经元核心偏置功耗 41.711 µW；1.4 µs 单元读取正端能量 3.338 pJ；5 ms 保持期内选中状态漂移 0.531 mV；提交/耦合误差分别报告。软件 checkpoint 在 DSEC 六类留出集 mIoU 27.976%（非硬件精度）；SPICE 标定行为仿真单帧 24.26% mIoU，匹配 PyTorch 参考 26.22%。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于电路级可实现性证据与成本量化，并揭示存储复制与服务调度是大规模扩展的关键约束；全网络物理运行、系统级能量与失配鲁棒性尚未验证，属早期架构可行性研究。

title: Understanding Contextual Bias in Agricultural CNNs Through Hidden-Neuron Concept Induction
summary: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) can classify images using background-dominated patches that contain little or none of the target object, showing that they exploit contextual information. Previous studies detected this behavior through classification accuracy but say little about what CNN hidden layers represent. We investigate whether Concept Induction can reveal interpretable visual properties associated with hidden-neuron activations on contextual image patches. Using five agricultural datasets with high, moderate, and low contextual bias, we analyze four CNN architectures at three network depths and five patch locations. Quantitative image descriptors of each patch are encoded in a knowledge graph and used as background knowledge for Concept Induction, which derives logical expressions characterizing neuron activation. These expressions are tested on held-out images using the Mann-Whitney U test and Cliff's delta. Of 48,013 tested neuron-feature pairs, 13,164 (27.4%) were validated. Validation was most frequent at intermediate depths (mean 40.2% at mid layers versus 12.0% at deep layers), and no patch location dominated across datasets. Among the tested descriptors, edge, Gabor, and Tamura texture features had the highest validation rates. Stronger contextual bias did not correspond to higher neuron-feature validation rates: moderately biased Sugarcane had the highest rate (40.5%) and highly biased Cassava the lowest (19.2%). These results suggest that behavioral context dependence and the semantic interpretability of hidden neurons capture different aspects of CNN behavior, and that Concept Induction can complement patch-based bias detection.

AI.tldr: 用概念归纳（Concept Induction）从隐藏神经元激活中导出可解释逻辑表达式，检验CNN在上下文背景patch上的表征，发现行为层面的上下文依赖与神经元语义可解释性并不一致。
AI.motivation: 既有研究仅通过分类准确率证明CNN会利用背景主导patch（上下文偏置），但对隐藏层究竟表征了什么缺乏刻画，需方法揭示与神经元激活相关的可解释视觉属性。
AI.method: 五个农业数据集（高/中/低上下文偏置），四种CNN架构、三个网络深度、五种patch位置；将各patch的定量图像描述子编码进知识图谱作为背景知识，用Concept Induction导出刻画神经元激活的逻辑表达式，并在留出图像上用Mann-Whitney U检验与Cliff's delta验证。
AI.result: 48,013个神经元-特征对中13,164（27.4%）通过验证；中层验证率显著高于深层（40.2% vs 12.0%）；无单一patch位置在各数据集上占优；edge、Gabor、Tamura纹理描述子验证率最高；上下文偏置强度与验证率无正相关（中等偏置的Sugarcane最高40.5%，高偏置Cassava最低19.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 行为的上下文依赖与隐藏神经元的语义可解释性刻画CNN行为的不同侧面，Concept Induction可作为基于patch的偏置检测的补充手段。

title: Modeling the Frictional Contact of Continuum Robots with Environments through Linear Complementarity Problem
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR). 21 pages, 18 figures
summary: Accurate friction modeling in continuum robots is essential for precise motion control and path planning. However, current approaches make predictions only for the mechanism's internal friction that is limited by the boundary forces of the Coulomb friction cone, which fail to characterize the static friction and motion hysteresis. In this paper, we propose a novel friction model based on complementarity constraints under the Coulomb friction assumption. This model predicts various friction effects caused by environmental interactions, including both static and sliding frictions and hysteresis behavior, as well as the corresponding robot deformation induced by these interactions, which are crucial for the practical motion planning and control of continuum robots. Additionally, real-time implementation of this model can be achieved, meeting the demand for computational efficiency in robotic applications. Experimental validations demonstrated that this model is able to reduce the maximum tip position error from 45.4 mm in the frictionless model to 5.85 mm in our friction-included model with a 287.9 mm-long tendon-driven continuum robot.

AI.tldr: 提出基于互补约束（Coulomb摩擦锥内）的连续体机器人摩擦模型，可刻画静摩擦、滑动摩擦与迟滞，并预测由其引起的机器人形变，满足实时计算需求。
AI.motivation: 现有连续体机器人摩擦模型仅预测受Coulomb锥边界力约束的内部摩擦，无法描述静摩擦与运动迟滞，导致运动控制与路径规划精度不足。
AI.method: 在Coulomb摩擦假设下构建互补约束（complementarity constraints）公式化摩擦模型，同时纳入环境交互引发的静摩擦、滑动摩擦、迟滞效应及对应形变；求解形式支持实时实现。
AI.result: 在287.9 mm长的腱驱动连续体机器人上实验验证，末端最大位置误差由无摩擦模型的45.4 mm降至本模型的5.85 mm。
AI.conclusion: 互补约束摩擦模型可统一刻画连续体机器人静/动摩擦与迟滞，显著提升末端精度且具备实时性，可服务于实际运动规划与控制。

title: JVT: Just Video Transformer makes pixel-space video diffusion simple
comment: 23 pages
summary: Direct diffusion modeling of high-dimensional raw video data is challenging, and existing pixel-space methods often rely on specialized architectures. We introduce JVT (Just Video Transformer), a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer for pixel-space video diffusion, without a pretrained autoencoder, auxiliary detailers, cascaded stages, or U-Net-style skip connections. We systematically examine video patch embeddings, register tokens, and adaptive layer normalization to identify design choices that balance generation quality and computational efficiency. The resulting JVT design achieves generation quality competitive with latent diffusion baselines in both class-conditioned and unconditional settings. The pixel-space formulation of JVT also naturally supports joint generation of pixel-aligned modalities. We demonstrate this capability through camera-conditioned RGB-disparity generation, which improves camera following relative to RGB-only baselines and yields explicit scene geometry without an additional reconstruction model at inference. These results highlight the potential of simple DiT-style Transformers for pixel-space video diffusion, and we hope our findings offer useful insights and practical guidance for future research.

AI.tldr: JVT: a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer that performs pixel-space video diffusion directly on high-dimensional raw video, without a pretrained autoencoder, detailers, cascades, or U-Net skips, and additionally supports pixel-aligned joint modality generation (e.g., RGB + disparity).
AI.motivation: Pixel-space video diffusion is hard due to high dimensionality, and existing methods lean on specialized architectures (latent autoencoders, cascaded detailers, U-Net skips). The authors ask whether a plain DiT-style Transformer with large patches can match latent diffusion quality while retaining pixel-alignment benefits.
AI.method: A DiT-style Transformer operating on large video patches in pixel space; systematic ablation of video patch embedding strategies, register tokens, and adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) to trade off quality vs. compute; no pretrained VAE, no auxiliary detailer, no cascade, no U-Net skip connections. Pixel-aligned modality joint generation is enabled by the shared pixel representation, demonstrated via camera-conditioned RGB-disparity generation.
AI.result: Generation quality competitive with latent-diffusion baselines in both class-conditioned and unconditional settings; camera-conditioned RGB-disparity joint generation improves camera-following over RGB-only baselines and yields explicit scene geometry without any extra reconstruction model at inference.
AI.conclusion: Simple DiT-style Transformers are a viable route to pixel-space video diffusion; the pixel-space formulation naturally affords joint pixel-aligned multimodal generation, offering practical design guidance (patch embedding, register tokens, AdaLN) for future work.

title: Restoring Diversity in Distilled Image and Video Generators by Probing Activations
summary: Distilling diffusion models into few-step student models substantially reduces sampling latency, but induces severe diversity collapse: samples generated from different random seeds show minimal variation. In this work, we investigate the root cause of this failure by probing the internal representations of student models relative to their teachers. We find that distilled students maintain total activation variance comparable to their teachers, but concentrate it into substantially fewer directions. This directional collapse is localized to an identifiable intermediate block at the initial denoising step. Consequently, diversity collapse stems from a misallocation of activation variance rather than an inherent loss of generative capacity. Guided by this finding, we propose ReDiverse to reinstate the missing variance directions. At training time, ReDiverse-FT fine-tunes a lightweight adapter that regresses student activations onto the teacher's, reviving the teacher's feature variance characteristic. At inference time, ReDiverse-TF introduces a training-free mechanism that steers activations along precomputed teacher principal directions. Across image and video distillation benchmarks, ReDiverse consistently restores sample diversity while preserving generation quality, further supported by the user study.

AI.tldr: 分析扩散模型蒸馏到少步学生模型时的多样性坍缩（diversity collapse）成因：并非生成能力丧失，而是激活方差集中到更少方向（方向性坍缩），定位在初始去噪步的中间块；据此提出 ReDiverse（微调适配器 ReDiverse-FT 与免训练主方向引导 ReDiverse-TF）恢复样本多样性。
AI.motivation: 少步蒸馏大幅降低采样延迟，但不同随机种子生成的样本差异极小，出现严重多样性坍缩；作者希望找到该失败的机制性根因，而非仅做经验性修补。
AI.method: 对比学生与教师模型内部表征：发现学生总激活方差与教师相当，但集中在极少数方向上。该方向性坍缩定位于初始去噪步的某个可识别的中间块。方法包含两组件：ReDiverse-FT 在训练时用轻量适配器将学生激活回归到教师激活，恢复教师特征方差特性；ReDiverse-TF 在推理时免训练地沿预计算的教师主成分方向引导激活。
AI.result: 在图像与视频蒸馏基准上，ReDiverse 在保持生成质量的同时一致地恢复样本多样性，并得到用户研究支持。
AI.conclusion: 多样性坍缩源于激活方差的方向性错配，而非生成容量固有限制；通过对齐教师激活的方向方差结构，可在几乎不增加训练成本（或零训练）的前提下修复多样性。

title: BAL: Bidirectional Autoregression in Latent Space for Learning Human Movement Representations
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Learning semantically meaningful human movement representations from 3D pose sequences is essential for human behavior modeling. Existing self-supervised methods derive supervision from artificial assumptions, e.g., invariance to augmentation within a certain range or recoverability of masked regions at a certain temporal scale, introducing heuristic hyperparameters that make the learned semantics sensitive to their settings. We propose BAL, a self-supervised framework that instead exploits supervision intrinsic to human movement: the natural ordering structure of everyday behavior. BAL autoregressively predicts in a semantically abstract latent space, analogous to how humans anticipate others' actions rather than their precise joint configurations. Bidirectional autoregressive prediction, both forward and backward in time, fully leverages these ordering constraints while enabling representation extraction using both past and future context at inference. To suppress representation collapse, BAL decomposes each prediction target into a global component capturing sequence-level semantics and a local component capturing context-independent movement. We prove that the local targets retain nontrivial angular diversity unless the representations are completely collapsed, preserving a meaningful training signal. Experiments on large-scale datasets demonstrate that BAL's representations are highly effective for motion captioning, forecasting, and interpolation, outperforming baselines on most evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出BAL自监督框架，利用人体运动内在的时间顺序结构，在语义抽象的潜空间中做双向自回归预测，通过全局/局部分解抑制表示坍缩。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督人体运动表示依赖人为假设（增广不变性、掩码重建的时间尺度），引入启发式超参使语义对设置敏感，缺乏本质监督信号。
AI.method: 在抽象潜空间做前向与后向双向自回归预测，利用日常行为自然有序结构作为监督；将预测目标分解为捕获序列级语义的全局分量与捕获上下文无关运动的局部分量以抑制表示坍缩；并证明除非表示完全坍缩，局部目标保持非平凡角度多样性。
AI.result: 在大规模数据集上，BAL表示在动作描述生成、运动预测与插值任务中多数指标优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 以内在顺序结构替代人为假设的自监督范式可学得高判别性运动表示，且双向自回归与全局/局部分解设计有效防坍缩。

title: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
summary: Robot-use agents (RUAs) have emerged as a promising approach to general-purpose robot control. However, strong performance has so far been achieved only by frontier proprietary models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2, whereas open-weight models remain substantially less capable. We show that an open-weight 27B reasoning model can be trained to use real robots natively through reinforcement learning, entirely in simulation and without demonstrations. Like a computer-use agent (CUA), the model observes the environment, reasons in a chain of thought, and generates the next end-effector pose, without any harness. We build a Post-training Engine for Agentic Robotics (PEAR) and use it to train the model on simulated robot tasks at scale with robot-use reinforcement learning (RURL), mirroring how frontier models acquire computer use. We find that the skills acquired in simulation generalize well beyond the training tasks: they transfer to an unseen robot, to the real world, and to novel instructions. After training on LIBERO and RoboDojo in simulation, the model succeeds in 60% of our trials on a real dual-arm robot, whereas the base model succeeds in none. On LIBERO, training raises the success rate from 1.6% to 74.4%, approaching GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol at maximum reasoning effort. Compared with $\pi_{0.5}$, a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on demonstrations, our model is substantially more robust to changes in the task itself. On LIBERO-Pro, $\pi_{0.5}$ succeeds in only 0.75% of episodes when assigned a new task in a familiar scene whereas our model succeeds in 57.4%. Finally, the model retains its general capabilities, with no measurable degradation on nine reasoning, coding and vision benchmarks. These results highlight robot-use reinforcement learning as a promising component of foundation-model post-training.

AI.tldr: 开源27B推理模型通过纯仿真、无示教的机器人使用强化学习（RURL）训练，可直接以思维链+末端位姿输出控制真实机器人，并泛化到未见机器人、真实世界与新指令。
AI.motivation: 机器人使用智能体（RUA）能力目前仅由闭源前沿模型（如GPT-6 Astra）具备，开源权重模型差距明显；作者希望复现"计算机使用智能体"的后训练路径，让开源模型原生具备真实机器人操作能力。
AI.method: 构建Post-training Engine for Agentic Robotics (PEAR)训练引擎，对27B推理模型在仿真环境（LIBERO、RoboDojo）中大规模执行机器人使用强化学习（RURL）：模型无harness，直接观测环境、产生思维链推理并输出下一末端执行器位姿；训练全程无演示数据。
AI.result: LIBERO成功率1.6%→74.4%，接近GPT-6 Astra/GPT-6.1 Sol最大推理努力水平；真实双臂机器人试验成功率60%（基座模型为0）；LIBERO-Pro新任务设定下57.4% vs π0.5仅0.75%；九项推理、代码与视觉基准无退化。
AI.conclusion: 仿真中的机器人使用强化学习可获得跨机器人本体、跨仿真-真实、跨指令的强泛化，且不损害通用能力，表明RURL可作为基础模型后训练的重要组成。
